guide.summary: 把 pulls a known, specific object in front of the verb so the sentence can say what was done TO it: where it ended up, what state it is in now, who got it. So the verb can never stand bare after 把: something must follow it (a result, a direction, 了, 在/到/给 + destination, 一下). Think 'take X and do-something-to-completion'. No change to the object, no 把.

subs.label: 把 + object + verb + result
subs.focus: Learner must place the object between 把 and the verb and keep verb + result (完, 好, 坏, 干净, 上, 掉, 错) together, with 了 last. Errors: object left after the verb (我把喝完了咖啡), result split off, 把 before the subject. Rewrites go from SVO + result to 把 and back.

subs.label: 把 + object + verb + direction
subs.focus: 把 with directional complements (拿出来, 带回去, 搬进去, 拿走, 带来). Learner must keep the object before the verb and the whole direction after it. Errors: object inside or after the complement (把拿书出来, 把拿出来书), or dropping the direction so the verb is bare.

subs.label: Obligatory 把: 放在 / 送到 / 交给 / 翻译成 / 当作
subs.focus: Verb + 在 / 到 / 给 / 成 / 作 + place, person or new form, with a specific object: the object must go forward with 把. Force 把 over English order (我放书在桌子上, 他翻译这句话成中文) and test which of 在 / 到 / 给 / 成 fits the verb.

subs.label: No bare verb after 把
subs.focus: Minimal endings when there is no result or direction: 了 (with 吃, 喝, 卖, 扔, 忘, 丢, 脱), reduplication (擦一擦), 一下. Learner must reject a bare verb (我把作业做, 请把门关) and pick a fitting ending. Cloze should offer ∅ as the tempting wrong option.

subs.label: 没 / 别 / modals / adverbs go before 把
subs.focus: 没, 别, 不要, modals (可以, 能, 要, 想, 应该) and time adverbs (已经, 还没, 马上) go before 把, not between object and verb. Errors: 你把车可以停在这儿, 我把没作业做完. 把…没 + verb is said colloquially: never judge-wrong. Also test 没 (not 不, and no 了) for an action not done. Keep 把 and the negator or modal as separate tiles.

subs.label: Verbs that cannot take 把
subs.focus: Verbs that do nothing to the object take plain SVO: 是, 有, 在; 喜欢, 知道, 觉得, 认识; 来, 去, 到, 回; perception with only 见 / 到 (看见, 听到). Learner must reject 我把他喜欢, 我把他看见了. Mix in correct look-alikes for judge items (把字看清楚了, 把这件事忘了).

subs.label: The 把 object is specific
subs.focus: The 把 object is identifiable (这 / 那, 我的, pronoun, bare noun = 'the ...'); a new counted object (一本书, 两杯咖啡) stays after the verb. Learner chooses 把那本书看完了 or 看完了一本书 from the cue ('the / that / my' or 'a / some / two'). 把 + 一 + measure is accepted colloquially: never use it as a judge-wrong sentence.

subs.label: 把 or plain SVO?
subs.focus: Is 把 possible at all? Plain SVO for habits, ongoing actions and statements with no outcome (我每天喝咖啡), and for potential complements (做不完, 看得懂). Errors: 我把这些作业做不完, 我每天把咖啡喝. Definite object + result allows both orders: use rewrites, never judge one as wrong.

rules.rule: Put the specific object right after 把, then the verb with its result. Verb and result stay glued together; 了 comes after them.
rules.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + Verb + Result + (了)

rules.note: Requests and plans (请把门关上, 我想把房间打扫干净) have no 了 because nothing has happened yet.

rules.rule: With a direction after the verb (出来, 回去, 进去, 走, 下), the object goes before the verb with 把 and the whole direction follows the verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + Verb + Direction + (了)

rules.note: Without 把, other orders exist (拿出一本书来), but once 把 is used the object can only be in front of the verb.

rules.rule: If the verb is followed by 在 / 到 + place, or has 给 + person attached to it, in standard Mandarin a specific object does not stay after the verb. Move it forward with 把.
rules.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + Verb + 在 / 到 / 给 + Place / Person

examples.zh: 我把手机放在桌子上了。
examples.py: wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le

examples.zh: 司机把我们送到了机场。
examples.py: sī jī bǎ wǒ men sòng dào le jī chǎng
examples.en: The driver took us to the airport.

rules.note: 在 is for where the thing rests (放在, 写在, 挂在, 停在); 到 is for where it is moved to (送到, 搬到, 带到, 拿到). Giving verbs have other orders without 把 when the object is new or counted (他还了我一本书, 我寄了一封信给他), so only test 把 + specific object + 交给 / 还给 / 送给 + person against clearly wrong orders.

rules.rule: Turning something into something else, or treating it as something, also needs 把: verb + 成 / 作 must be followed directly by the new form.
rules.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + Verb + 成 / 作 + New form

examples.zh: 他把这个句子翻译成了中文。
examples.py: tā bǎ zhè ge jù zi fān yì chéng le zhōng wén
examples.en: He translated this sentence into Chinese.

examples.zh: 我一直把他当作好朋友。
examples.py: wǒ yī zhí bǎ tā dàng zuò hǎo péng you
examples.en: I have always thought of him as a good friend.

examples.zh: 对不起，我把十看成了七。
examples.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ bǎ shí kàn chéng le qī
examples.en: Sorry, I misread ten as seven.

rules.note: 当作 and 当成 mean the same here. 把…当作… describes an attitude, so it can be negated with 不 and takes no 了.

rules.rule: A 把 sentence cannot end in a bare verb. If there is no result or direction, add at least 了, a reduplicated verb, or 一下.
rules.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + Verb + 了 / Verb + 一 + Verb / Verb + 一下

examples.py: nǐ bǎ zhè bēi shuǐ hē le ba

examples.py: wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn shì wàng le

examples.py: nǐ bǎ zhuō zi cā yī cā
examples.en: Give the table a wipe.

examples.py: qǐng bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo yī xià

rules.note: 了 alone is enough mainly with verbs whose action uses up, removes or loses the object (吃, 喝, 卖, 扔, 丢, 忘, 脱, 关). With other verbs a result is safer: 把作业做完了 rather than 把作业做了, though the short form is heard in casual speech.

rules.rule: Negation goes before 把, not before the verb. Use 没 for something that did not get done (and drop 了); use 别 or 不要 for 'don't'.
rules.pattern: Subject + 没 / 别 / 不要 + 把 + Object + Verb + more

examples.py: wǒ méi bǎ zuò yè dài lái

examples.py: bié bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài chuáng shàng

examples.py: bù yào bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào su tā
examples.en: Don't tell him about this.

rules.note: Plain 不 before 把 is for attitudes, conditions and refusals (他不把我当朋友; 你不把饭吃完，就不能出去玩). A past event that did not happen takes 没把. 把…没 + verb (他把作业没做完) is heard in casual speech but is not the standard order.

rules.rule: Modal verbs and time adverbs also go before 把.
rules.pattern: Subject + 可以 / 要 / 想 / 应该 / 已经 / 马上 + 把 + Object + Verb + more

examples.py: nǐ yīng gāi bǎ yào chī le
examples.en: You should take your medicine.

rules.note: One regular exception: 都 and 全, when they sum up the object, come after it: 我把作业都做完了.

rules.rule: No 把 with verbs that do nothing to the object: 是, 有, 在; liking and knowing (喜欢, 知道, 觉得, 认识); coming and going (来, 去, 到, 回); and seeing or hearing with only 见 / 到 (看见, 听到). Use plain SVO.

examples.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè ge diàn yǐng

examples.en: I've known about this for a long time.

examples.py: tā qù nián qù le běi jīng
examples.en: He went to Beijing last year.

rules.note: 看 and 听 do take 把 when a real result follows (我把黑板上的字看清楚了, 把这首歌听完). 忘 is also fine with 把 (把这件事忘了) even though it is a mental verb.

rules.rule: The object of 把 is normally something specific that the listener can identify (这 / 那, 我的, a pronoun, or a bare noun meaning 'the ...'). A new object counted with 一 / 两 / 几 stays after the verb.
rules.pattern: 把 + 这 / 那 / 我的 / bare noun ...   BUT   Verb + Result + 了 + number + measure + Object

examples.en: I bought two pieces of clothing at the shop.

rules.note: 一 + measure does occur after 把 when the speaker has one particular thing in mind (我把一件重要的事忘了), and casual speech allows more (我把一杯咖啡喝完了). As a working rule: 'a / some' in English means no 把.

rules.rule: Habits, actions in progress and plain statements with no outcome take ordinary SVO. 把 needs a specific thing and something that happens to it.

examples.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang hē kā fēi

examples.py: tā zài fáng jiān lǐ kàn shū

examples.py: wǒ bǎ nà bēi kā fēi hē wán le
examples.en: I finished that cup of coffee.

rules.note: With a specific object and a simple result, both orders are correct; 把 puts the attention on what became of the object and is the more usual choice in requests (请把门关上).

rules.rule: 'Can / cannot manage to' complements (verb + 得 / 不 + result) never combine with 把. Keep the object after the verb, or say 能把 / 没把 with a normal result instead.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得 / 不 + Result + Object

examples.zh: 我今天能把这些作业做完。
examples.py: wǒ jīn tiān néng bǎ zhè xiē zuò yè zuò wán
examples.en: I can get this homework finished today.

right.py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le

contrasts.why: The verb cannot be bare after 把. Say what became of the homework: 做完了.

right.zh: 我把手机放在桌子上了。
right.py: wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
right.en: I put my phone on the table.

contrasts.why: English order 'put the phone on the table' does not work in standard Mandarin: 放 and 在 stay together, so the object moves forward with 把. (放手机在桌子上 is heard in some regional speech.)

contrasts.wrong: 他翻译这个句子成中文了。

right.zh: 他把这个句子翻译成中文了。
right.py: tā bǎ zhè ge jù zi fān yì chéng zhōng wén le
right.en: He translated this sentence into Chinese.

contrasts.why: 翻译成 must be followed straight away by the new form (中文), so the thing translated goes before the verb with 把.

right.py: wǒ méi bǎ zuò yè zuò wán

contrasts.why: 没 goes before 把, not after it, and 了 is dropped after 没. (把作业没做完 is heard in casual speech, but 没把 is the standard order.)

right.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chē tíng zài zhè r
right.en: You can park the car here.

contrasts.why: Modal verbs such as 可以 stand before 把, never between the object and the verb.

right.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè ge diàn yǐng

contrasts.why: Liking something does nothing to it, so 喜欢 cannot be used with 把.
Seeing someone does not change or move them. 看见 takes its object after the verb.

right.py: wǒ zuò bù wán zhè xiē zuò yè

contrasts.why: 做不完 says the result cannot be reached, and 把 needs a result that is reached. The two never combine.

right.py: qǐng bǎ shū ná chū lái

contrasts.why: The object comes directly after 把; the verb and its direction follow as one block.

cheat: 把 + the thing + verb + what happened to it. Never stop at the bare verb.
放在 / 送到 / 交给 / 翻译成 / 当作 with a specific object: 把 is the standard way.
没, 别, 不要, 可以, 想, 要, 已经 all go BEFORE 把. Didn't happen = 没把, with no 了.
English 'a / some / two ...' object: no 把, plain SVO. 'The / that / my ...': 把 is open.
是, 有, 喜欢, 知道, 觉得, 来, 去, 看见, 听到: no 把.
做不完 / 看得懂 (can or can't manage): no 把.
Nothing happens to the object (habit, ongoing action)? Plain SVO.

items.zh: 老师把答案写在黑板上了。
items.py: lǎo shī bǎ dá àn xiě zài hēi bǎn shàng le
items.en: The teacher wrote the answers on the blackboard.
items.why: 写在 plus a place with a specific object means 把 first. The place stays right after 写在, and 了 closes the sentence.

items.zh: 我把作业写完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè xiě wán le
items.en: I've finished my homework.
items.why: 把 moves 作业 in front of the verb, and the verb stays glued to its result 完, with 了 last. The object cannot sit between 写 and 完.

items.s: 你别把窗户关上，屋里太热了。
items.s_py: nǐ bié bǎ chuāng hu guān shàng wū lǐ tài rè le
items.zh: 你别把窗户关上，屋里太热了。
items.py: nǐ bié bǎ chuāng hu guān shàng wū lǐ tài rè le
items.en: Don't close the window; it's too hot in the room.
items.why: 别 before 把, and 关上 keeps its result. This is the normal prohibition.

items.s: 你把自行车可以放在门口。
items.s_py: nǐ bǎ zì xíng chē kě yǐ fàng zài mén kǒu
items.zh: 你可以把自行车放在门口。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ zì xíng chē fàng zài mén kǒu
items.en: You can leave your bike at the door.
items.why: Modal verbs like 可以 go before 把. They cannot appear between the object and the verb.

items.src: 小王弄丢了会议室的钥匙。
items.src_py: xiǎo wáng nòng diū le huì yì shì de yào shi
items.zh: 小王把会议室的钥匙弄丢了。
items.py: xiǎo wáng bǎ huì yì shì de yào shi nòng diū le
items.en: Xiao Wang has lost the meeting room key.
items.why: The key is specific, so it goes after 把. 弄丢 keeps its result and 了 ends the clause.

items.s: 我把作业做。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè zuò
items.zh: 我把作业做完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le
items.en: I've finished my homework.
items.why: The verb after 把 must be followed by something, such as the result 完 and 了. 做 alone does not work.

items.q: 你___把这件事告诉别人，这是公司的秘密。
items.zh: 你不要把这件事告诉别人，这是公司的秘密。
items.py: nǐ bù yào bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào su bié ren zhè shì gōng sī de mì mì
items.en: Don't tell anyone about this; it's a company secret.
items.why: 'Don't' is 不要 before 把. 没 reports a past non-event, and 不是 and 不会 do not warn someone against doing something.

items.s: 同学们没把作业交上来。
items.s_py: tóng xué men méi bǎ zuò yè jiāo shàng lái
items.zh: 同学们没把作业交上来。
items.py: tóng xué men méi bǎ zuò yè jiāo shàng lái
items.en: The students didn't hand in their homework.
items.why: 没 before 把, with the direction 上来 kept together and no 了. This is the correct negative.

items.s: 他翻译这个句子成中文了。
items.s_py: tā fān yì zhè ge jù zi chéng zhōng wén le
items.zh: 他把这个句子翻译成中文了。
items.py: tā bǎ zhè ge jù zi fān yì chéng zhōng wén le
items.en: He translated this sentence into Chinese.
items.why: 翻译成 must be followed directly by the new form, so the sentence being translated has to go forward with 把.

items.q: 请把门关___。
items.zh: 请把门关上。
items.py: qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng
items.en: Please close the door.
items.why: After 把门 the verb needs a result, and 关上 says the door ends up shut. 得, 过 and 的 give no result, so the verb would be left bare.

items.q: 我很喜欢___这位新老师。
items.zh: 我很喜欢这位新老师。
items.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè wèi xīn lǎo shī
items.en: I really like this new teacher.
items.why: 喜欢 does nothing to its object, so it takes a plain object after the verb and never 把.

items.q: 老师___我的作业改完了。
items.zh: 老师把我的作业改完了。
items.py: lǎo shī bǎ wǒ de zuò yè gǎi wán le
items.en: The teacher has finished marking my homework.
items.why: The teacher does something to a specific object and ends with the result 完, which is the 把 pattern. 被 would make 老师 the thing acted on by my homework, which makes no sense.

items.src_py: nǐ bǎ yī fu fàng zài dì shàng
items.zh: 你别把衣服放在地上。
items.py: nǐ bié bǎ yī fu fàng zài dì shàng
items.en: Don't put your clothes on the floor.
items.why: 别 goes before 把. Placing it between the object and the verb is not allowed.

items.src_py: nǐ guān yī xià dēng
items.task: Make it a polite request with 请 and 把.
items.zh: 请把灯关一下。
items.py: qǐng bǎ dēng guān yī xià
items.en: Please turn the light off.
items.why: The light goes after 把 and 一下 follows the verb as its ending. 请 replaces the subject 你.

items.q: 我把___本书看完了。
items.zh: 我把那本书看完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū kàn wán le
items.en: I finished reading that book.
items.why: The 把 object must be specific, and 那 makes it 'that book'. 一, 两 and 几 would introduce an unspecified or counted book, which stays after the verb.

items.zh: 请你把会议需要的材料带过来。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ huì yì xū yào de cái liào dài guò lái
items.en: Please bring over the materials the meeting needs.
items.why: The long specific object goes after 把, and 带过来 follows as one block. The direction cannot be split off from the verb.

items.zh: 请把灯打开。
items.py: qǐng bǎ dēng dǎ kāi
items.en: Please turn on the light.
items.why: The object follows 把 straight away and 打开 stays together as verb plus result. A bare 打 would not be allowed.

items.zh: 我昨天看完了一本书。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn wán le yī běn shū
items.en: I finished a book yesterday.
items.why: A new, counted object like 一本书 stays after the verb. 把 would need a specific object such as 那本书. 昨天 may also come before 我.

items.src: 我昨天交了作业给李老师。
items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān jiāo le zuò yè gěi lǐ lǎo shī
items.zh: 我昨天把作业交给了李老师。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ zuò yè jiāo gěi le lǐ lǎo shī
items.en: I handed my homework to Teacher Li yesterday.
items.why: The homework goes after 把, and 交给了 is followed directly by the person receiving it. The time word may come before or after 我.

items.src: 他打开了办公室的门，走了进去。
items.src_py: tā dǎ kāi le bàn gōng shì de mén zǒu le jìn qù
items.task: Rewrite the first clause with 把.
items.zh: 他把办公室的门打开了，走了进去。
items.py: tā bǎ bàn gōng shì de mén dǎ kāi le zǒu le jìn qù
items.en: He opened the office door and walked in.
items.why: The door goes after 把 and 打开了 closes the first clause. The second clause, 走了进去, stays unchanged.

items.zh: 王老师把同学们交上来的作业都改完了。
items.py: wáng lǎo shī bǎ tóng xué men jiāo shàng lái de zuò yè dōu gǎi wán le
items.en: Teacher Wang has marked all the homework the students handed in.
items.why: The long object phrase goes right after 把, with 都 after it summing up the object. The verb keeps 完 and 了 at the end.

items.q: 他把杯子摔___了。
items.zh: 他把杯子摔坏了。
items.py: tā bǎ bēi zi shuāi huài le
items.en: He dropped the cup and broke it.
items.why: The result complement must say what became of the cup: 摔坏 means it broke. 摔完, 摔走 and 摔上 cannot describe a dropped cup.

items.src_py: wǒ zuò wán le liàn xí
items.zh: 我把练习做完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ liàn xí zuò wán le
items.en: I finished the exercises.
items.why: The specific object goes after 把, and 做完 stays together before 了. 完 cannot be separated from 做.

items.zh: 我已经把邮件发给同事了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ yóu jiàn fā gěi tóng shì le
items.en: I've already sent the email to my colleagues.
items.why: The time adverb 已经 sits before 把. 发给 plus a person follows the object, and 了 ends the sentence.

items.q: 他把这篇课文翻译___了中文。
items.zh: 他把这篇课文翻译成了中文。
items.py: tā bǎ zhè piān kè wén fān yì chéng le zhōng wén
items.en: He translated this text into Chinese.
items.why: Turning one language into another is 翻译成, with the new form right after. 翻译给, 翻译在 and 翻译到 cannot introduce a language.

items.zh: 秘书把签好的合同送到了客户那里。
items.py: mì shū bǎ qiān hǎo de hé tong sòng dào le kè hù nà li
items.en: The secretary took the signed contract to the client.
items.why: 送到了 plus a place needs the object forward with 把. The signed contract is specific, and the place follows 送到了 directly.

items.q: 经理把我叫___办公室，问了我很多问题。
items.zh: 经理把我叫进办公室，问了我很多问题。
items.py: jīng lǐ bǎ wǒ jiào jìn bàn gōng shì wèn le wǒ hěn duō wèn tí
items.en: The manager called me into his office and asked me a lot of questions.
items.why: 叫进办公室 uses the direction 进 to say someone was called into a room. 叫下 and 叫起 do not take a room, and 叫上 would mean calling someone to come along.

items.zh: 经理把文件交给了秘书。
items.py: jīng lǐ bǎ wén jiàn jiāo gěi le mì shū
items.en: The manager handed the file to the secretary.
items.why: 交给 plus a person needs the file in front of the verb with 把. The recipient follows 交给了 directly.

items.q: 经理把会议推迟___下周一了。
items.zh: 经理把会议推迟到下周一了。
items.py: jīng lǐ bǎ huì yì tuī chí dào xià zhōu yī le
items.en: The manager postponed the meeting until next Monday.
items.why: 推迟到 gives the time something is moved to. 推迟在 and 推迟给 are not used, and 着 would only describe a state.

items.s: 我今天能把这些邮件回复完。
items.s_py: wǒ jīn tiān néng bǎ zhè xiē yóu jiàn huí fù wán
items.zh: 我今天能把这些邮件回复完。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān néng bǎ zhè xiē yóu jiàn huí fù wán
items.en: I can finish replying to these emails today.
items.why: 能 comes before 把, with the result 完 on the verb. This is fine, unlike a potential form such as 回复不完 with 把.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ zhè xiē yóu jiàn huí fù le
items.task: Say you already did it (已经).
items.zh: 我已经把这些邮件回复了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ zhè xiē yóu jiàn huí fù le
items.en: I've already replied to these emails.
items.why: The time adverb 已经 goes before 把. The verb ends with 了.

items.src_py: qǐng jiāo zuò yè gěi lǎo shī
items.zh: 请把作业交给老师。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zuò yè jiāo gěi lǎo shī
items.en: Please hand your homework to the teacher.
items.why: 把 puts the homework before the verb, and 交给 is followed straight away by the person receiving it.

items.zh: 请把房间打扫一下。
items.py: qǐng bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo yī xià
items.en: Please tidy up the room a bit.
items.why: With no result, 一下 gives the verb the ending that 把 needs. 打扫 alone would be a bare verb.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè dài lái le
items.zh: 我没把作业带来。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ zuò yè dài lái
items.en: I didn't bring my homework.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, and the 了 is dropped. 我把作业没带来 puts the negator in the wrong place.

items.s: 小王把我们公司的经理认识。
items.s_py: xiǎo wáng bǎ wǒ men gōng sī de jīng lǐ rèn shi
items.zh: 小王认识我们公司的经理。
items.py: xiǎo wáng rèn shi wǒ men gōng sī de jīng lǐ
items.en: Xiao Wang knows our company's manager.
items.why: 认识 states knowing and does nothing to the manager, so no 把.

items.s: 请把这份文件复印两份。
items.s_py: qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn fù yìn liǎng fèn
items.zh: 请把这份文件复印两份。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn fù yìn liǎng fèn
items.en: Please make two copies of this document.
items.why: The 把 object 这份文件 is specific. The counted 两份 is the amount of copies, not the object, so this is correct.

items.src_py: lǎo shī gěi le wǒ zuò yè běn
items.task: Rewrite with 把, keeping 给.
items.zh: 老师把作业本给我了。
items.py: lǎo shī bǎ zuò yè běn gěi wǒ le
items.en: The teacher gave me my exercise book.
items.why: With 把 the thing given goes before the verb, and 给 is followed by the person. 了 may sit after 给 or at the end.

items.s: 他每天把咖啡喝。
items.s_py: tā měi tiān bǎ kā fēi hē
items.zh: 他每天喝咖啡。
items.py: tā měi tiān hē kā fēi
items.en: He drinks coffee every day.
items.why: A habit has no specific outcome for the object, so it takes plain SVO. 把 would also leave 喝 bare.

items.src_py: tóng xué men ná lái le yǐ zi
items.zh: 同学们把椅子拿来了。
items.py: tóng xué men bǎ yǐ zi ná lái le
items.en: The students brought the chairs over.
items.why: The chairs are specific, so they go after 把. The verb keeps its direction 来 and ends in 了.

items.zh: 小李把箱子搬上楼了。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ xiāng zi bān shàng lóu le
items.en: Xiao Li carried the box upstairs.
items.why: The box goes after 把 and the direction 搬上楼 stays together after the verb. The object cannot be put between 搬 and 上楼.

items.q: 他昨天忘了，所以___把报告交给经理。
items.zh: 他昨天忘了，所以没把报告交给经理。
items.py: tā zuó tiān wàng le suǒ yǐ méi bǎ bào gào jiāo gěi jīng lǐ
items.en: He forgot yesterday, so he didn't hand the report to the manager.
items.why: An action that did not happen in the past is 没 before 把, with no 了. 不 would be a refusal, which clashes with having forgotten; 别 and 要 are commands or wishes.

items.s: 我在走廊里把李老师看见了。
items.s_py: wǒ zài zǒu láng lǐ bǎ lǐ lǎo shī kàn jiàn le
items.zh: 我在走廊里看见李老师了。
items.py: wǒ zài zǒu láng lǐ kàn jiàn lǐ lǎo shī le
items.en: I saw Teacher Li in the corridor.
items.why: Seeing someone does not change them, so 看见 takes a plain object after the verb.

items.zh: 请把这些材料送到会议室去。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè xiē cái liào sòng dào huì yì shì qù
items.en: Please take these materials to the meeting room.
items.why: 送到 plus a place needs the object up front with 把. The object cannot come after 送到, because the place has to follow it directly.

items.src_py: tā bǎ bào gào jiāo gěi jīng lǐ le
items.task: Say he still hasn't done it (还没).
items.zh: 他还没把报告交给经理。
items.py: tā hái méi bǎ bào gào jiāo gěi jīng lǐ
items.en: He still hasn't given the report to the manager.
items.why: 还没 goes before 把 and takes away the 了. 把报告还没交 would be wrong.

items.zh: 我把笔记本放在桌子上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ bǐ jì běn fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.en: I put my notebook on the desk.
items.why: With 放在 plus a place, the specific object must go forward with 把. 我放笔记本在桌子上了 is the English-style order that Chinese does not allow.

items.q: 请把这封信交___李老师。
items.zh: 请把这封信交给李老师。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jiāo gěi lǐ lǎo shī
items.en: Please hand this letter to Teacher Li.
items.why: 交给 is 'hand over to' a person. 交在 and 交成 do not work, and 交到 needs a place or a 手里 after the person.

items.src_py: nǐ bǎ chē tíng zài zhè r
items.zh: 你可以把车停在这儿。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chē tíng zài zhè r
items.en: You can park the car here.
items.why: The modal 可以 stands before 把. The object stays in front of the verb and 在这儿 follows 停.

items.q: 学生把答案写___了，老师让他重写。
items.zh: 学生把答案写错了，老师让他重写。
items.py: xué sheng bǎ dá àn xiě cuò le lǎo shī ràng tā chóng xiě
items.en: The student wrote the answer wrong, so the teacher made him write it again.
items.why: The result is that the answer is wrong, so 错 is needed; the cue and the order to rewrite exclude 对 and 好. The verb and its result stay together after the object.

items.src_py: qǐng ná chū shū lái
items.zh: 请把书拿出来。
items.py: qǐng bǎ shū ná chū lái
items.en: Please take out your books.
items.why: With 把 the book goes directly after it and the whole direction 拿出来 follows the verb. The object cannot be split inside the complement.

items.s: 我把这个新同事很喜欢。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge xīn tóng shì hěn xǐ huan
items.zh: 我很喜欢这个新同事。
items.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè ge xīn tóng shì
items.en: I really like this new colleague.
items.why: 喜欢 does not do anything to its object, so it cannot take 把.

items.zh: 他把那份合同签了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà fèn hé tong qiān le
items.en: He signed that contract.
items.why: 那份合同 is specific, so it follows 把. 签 then needs 了 as its ending, because a bare verb cannot close a 把 sentence.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ zhè fèn bào gào xiě wán le
items.zh: 我想把这份报告写完。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè fèn bào gào xiě wán
items.en: I want to finish writing this report.
items.why: 想 goes before 把. The specific object and 写完 follow as usual, with no 了 for something not yet done.

items.src_py: tā qí zǒu le wǒ de zì xíng chē
items.zh: 他把我的自行车骑走了。
items.py: tā bǎ wǒ de zì xíng chē qí zǒu le
items.en: He rode off on my bike.
items.why: My bike is specific, so it goes forward with 把. 骑走 stays together and 了 ends the sentence.

items.q: 这么多作业，我今天做___完。
items.zh: 这么多作业，我今天做不完。
items.py: zhè me duō zuò yè wǒ jīn tiān zuò bù wán
items.en: With this much homework, I can't finish it today.
items.why: 做不完 is a potential complement saying the result cannot be reached, and it never combines with 把. 没 or 了 would not give a 'cannot manage' meaning.

items.s: 我把今天开会的时间忘了。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ jīn tiān kāi huì de shí jiān wàng le
items.zh: 我把今天开会的时间忘了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ jīn tiān kāi huì de shí jiān wàng le
items.en: I forgot the time of today's meeting.
items.why: 忘 is a mental verb, but it does take 把 when the thing is lost, and 了 gives it a proper ending.

items.zh: 别把会议时间弄错了。
items.py: bié bǎ huì yì shí jiān nòng cuò le
items.en: Don't get the meeting time wrong.
items.why: 别 goes before 把, and 弄错 stays together as verb plus result. 了 here marks the new situation of getting it wrong.

items.zh: 你可以把自行车停在门口。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ zì xíng chē tíng zài mén kǒu
items.en: You can park your bike at the door.
items.why: The modal 可以 stands before 把, never between the object and the verb. 停在门口 follows the object as one unit.

items.src_py: sī jī sòng wǒ men dào xué xiào le
items.zh: 司机把我们送到学校了。
items.py: sī jī bǎ wǒ men sòng dào xué xiào le
items.en: The driver took us to school.
items.why: 送到 plus a place works well with 把: the people being taken go forward, and the destination follows 送到.

items.src_py: qǐng dǎ sǎo bàn gōng shì
items.task: Rewrite with 把 and 一下.
items.zh: 请把办公室打扫一下。
items.py: qǐng bǎ bàn gōng shì dǎ sǎo yī xià
items.en: Please give the office a tidy.
items.why: The office goes after 把, and 一下 is the minimal ending that the verb needs.

items.s: 同学们把教室打扫。
items.s_py: tóng xué men bǎ jiào shì dǎ sǎo
items.zh: 同学们把教室打扫干净了。
items.py: tóng xué men bǎ jiào shì dǎ sǎo gān jìng le
items.en: The students cleaned the classroom.
items.why: A bare verb cannot close a 把 sentence. 打扫 needs a result, so 打扫干净了.

items.zh: 你把窗户擦一擦。
items.py: nǐ bǎ chuāng hu cā yī cā
items.en: Give the window a wipe.
items.why: The reduplicated 擦一擦 is the ending after 把, and the window goes before it. The doubled verb stays together after the object.

items.src_py: tā nòng huài le wǒ de diàn nǎo
items.zh: 他把我的电脑弄坏了。
items.py: tā bǎ wǒ de diàn nǎo nòng huài le
items.en: He broke my computer.
items.why: My computer is specific, so it goes forward with 把. 弄坏 stays glued together, and 了 goes last.

items.zh: 我没把课本带来。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ kè běn dài lái
items.en: I didn't bring my textbook.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, not before the verb, and there is no 了 after it. 我把课本没带来 is the typical mistake.

items.zh: 同事还没把会议材料准备好。
items.py: tóng shì hái méi bǎ huì yì cái liào zhǔn bèi hǎo
items.en: My colleague hasn't got the meeting materials ready yet.
items.why: 还 and 没 both go before 把. After 没 the 了 is dropped, and 准备好 keeps its result together.

items.src_py: tā bǎ nà fèn bào gào kàn wán le
items.zh: 他看完了那份报告。
items.py: tā kàn wán le nà fèn bào gào
items.en: He finished reading that report.
items.why: With a specific object and a simple result both orders are correct. Without 把 the object follows 看完了.

items.q: 请问，我可以___车停在办公楼前面吗？
items.zh: 请问，我可以把车停在办公楼前面吗？
items.py: qǐng wèn wǒ kě yǐ bǎ chē tíng zài bàn gōng lóu qián miàn ma
items.en: Excuse me, may I park the car in front of the office building?
items.why: The object goes forward with 把, and the modal 可以 stands before it. 让 would mean letting the car do something, and 被 or 给 would reverse or change the roles.

items.s: 他把黑板上的字看清楚了。
items.s_py: tā bǎ hēi bǎn shàng de zì kàn qīng chu le
items.zh: 他把黑板上的字看清楚了。
items.py: tā bǎ hēi bǎn shàng de zì kàn qīng chu le
items.en: He read the words on the blackboard clearly.
items.why: 看 normally resists 把, but with a real result like 清楚 it is fine.

items.zh: 别把书包放在椅子上。
items.py: bié bǎ shū bāo fàng zài yǐ zi shàng
items.en: Don't put your schoolbag on the chair.
items.why: 别 comes first, before 把, and the object goes before the verb. 把书包别放 would put the negation in the wrong place.

items.q: 我已经把借来的笔记还___同桌了。
items.zh: 我已经把借来的笔记还给同桌了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ jiè lái de bǐ jì huán gěi tóng zhuō le
items.en: I've already given the borrowed notes back to my desk-mate.
items.why: 还给 is 'give back to' a person, so the recipient follows 给 and the notes go forward with 把. 还在 and 还到 do not take a person.

items.q: 小李把旧电脑卖___，买了一台新的。
items.zh: 小李把旧电脑卖了，买了一台新的。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ jiù diàn nǎo mài le mǎi le yī tái xīn de
items.en: Xiao Li sold his old computer and bought a new one.
items.why: A 把 sentence cannot end on a bare verb, and 了 is enough for 卖 because the object is gone. Leaving it out gives a bare verb; 着 and 过 do not fit a completed sale.

items.s: 我把这些作业做不完。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè xiē zuò yè zuò bù wán
items.zh: 我做不完这些作业。
items.py: wǒ zuò bù wán zhè xiē zuò yè
items.en: I can't finish this homework.
items.why: 做不完 says the result cannot be reached, and 把 cannot combine with it.

items.s: 我看懂了这封信。
items.s_py: wǒ kàn dǒng le zhè fēng xìn
items.zh: 我看懂了这封信。
items.py: wǒ kàn dǒng le zhè fēng xìn
items.en: I understood this letter.
items.why: Plain SVO with a result complement is correct. 把 is not required here.

items.s: 学校把考试改到了下个月。
items.s_py: xué xiào bǎ kǎo shì gǎi dào le xià ge yuè
items.zh: 学校把考试改到了下个月。
items.py: xué xiào bǎ kǎo shì gǎi dào le xià ge yuè
items.en: The school has moved the exam to next month.
items.why: 改到 plus a time is a destination pattern with the specific object forward after 把.

items.src_py: tā bǎ wén jiàn ná huí lái le
items.zh: 他没把文件拿回来。
items.py: tā méi bǎ wén jiàn ná huí lái
items.en: He didn't bring the file back.
items.why: 没 goes before 把 and the 了 is dropped. 拿回来 stays as one block after the object.

items.zh: 老师把我的手机收起来了。
items.py: lǎo shī bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī shōu qǐ lái le
items.en: The teacher took my phone away.
items.why: My phone is specific, so it goes right after 把, and the whole direction 收起来 follows the verb as one block, then 了.

items.q: 同学们都把小王当___班长。
items.zh: 同学们都把小王当作班长。
items.py: tóng xué men dōu bǎ xiǎo wáng dàng zuò bān zhǎng
items.en: All the classmates treat Xiao Wang as the class monitor.
items.why: 当作 means 'treat as', and the object must go forward with 把. 当到, 当在 and 当给 are not words.

items.src_py: wǒ wàng le zhè jiàn shì
items.zh: 我把这件事忘了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn shì wàng le
items.en: I forgot about this.
items.why: 忘 is the usual verb that takes 把 with just 了, because the thing is lost. The object goes before the verb.

items.s: 昨天我在书店把一本新书买了。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǒ zài shū diàn bǎ yī běn xīn shū mǎi le
items.zh: 昨天我在书店买了一本新书。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ zài shū diàn mǎi le yī běn xīn shū
items.en: I bought a new book at the bookshop yesterday.
items.why: 一本新书 is a new, unspecified object, so it stays after the verb instead of going after 把.

items.src: 小李把这个问题解决了。
items.src_py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ zhè ge wèn tí jiě jué le
items.zh: 小李解决了这个问题。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ jiě jué le zhè ge wèn tí
items.en: Xiao Li solved this problem.
items.why: With a specific object and a simple result both orders are correct. In plain SVO the 了 follows the verb and the object comes last.

items.src_py: tā mài le jiù shǒu jī
items.zh: 他把旧手机卖了。
items.py: tā bǎ jiù shǒu jī mài le
items.en: He sold his old phone.
items.why: 卖 needs an ending after 把, and 了 is enough because the object is gone. A bare 卖 would not be allowed.

items.s: 你把这件事不要告诉同事。
items.s_py: nǐ bǎ zhè jiàn shì bù yào gào su tóng shì
items.zh: 你不要把这件事告诉同事。
items.py: nǐ bù yào bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào su tóng shì
items.en: Don't tell your colleagues about this.
items.why: 不要 goes before 把, never after the object.

items.zh: 请把作业本交上来。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zuò yè běn jiāo shàng lái
items.en: Please hand in your exercise books.
items.why: Object right after 把, then 交上来 as one block. 请交上来把作业本 and 请把交上来作业本 both break the order.

items.q: 他把椅子搬___教室里去了。
items.zh: 他把椅子搬进教室里去了。
items.py: tā bǎ yǐ zi bān jìn jiào shì lǐ qù le
items.en: He carried the chair into the classroom.
items.why: The direction after 搬 must match 'into the classroom': 搬进...去. 搬出 would mean out of it, and 搬下 and 搬起 do not take a room as a destination.

items.src_py: lǎo shī bǎ zuò yè běn fā wán le
items.zh: 老师发完了作业本。
items.py: lǎo shī fā wán le zuò yè běn
items.en: The teacher has finished handing out the exercise books.
items.why: Without 把 the object returns after the verb. 发完 and 了 come first, then the object.

items.src: 经理看完了所有的申请。
items.src_py: jīng lǐ kàn wán le suǒ yǒu de shēn qǐng
items.task: Rewrite with 把 and put 都 after the object.
items.zh: 经理把所有的申请都看完了。
items.py: jīng lǐ bǎ suǒ yǒu de shēn qǐng dōu kàn wán le
items.en: The manager has read all the applications.
items.why: 都 sums up the object, so it sits right after it and before the verb phrase. The verb keeps 完 and 了.

items.q: 他把文件一直放___抽屉里，没拿出来过。
items.zh: 他把文件一直放在抽屉里，没拿出来过。
items.py: tā bǎ wén jiàn yī zhí fàng zài chōu ti lǐ méi ná chū lái guo
items.en: He kept the file in the drawer the whole time and never took it out.
items.why: 放在 marks where something rests, which fits 一直 and a file that stays put. 放到 would stress being moved there, and 放给 or 放成 make no sense.

items.q: 小王把会议室打扫___了，大家可以进去了。
items.zh: 小王把会议室打扫干净了，大家可以进去了。
items.py: xiǎo wáng bǎ huì yì shì dǎ sǎo gān jìng le dà jiā kě yǐ jìn qù le
items.en: Xiao Wang cleaned the meeting room, so everyone can go in now.
items.why: 打扫干净 is the resultative that fits cleaning a room. 明白, 清楚 and 容易 are results of understanding or ease, not of sweeping.

items.zh: 老师把试卷发完了。
items.py: lǎo shī bǎ shì juàn fā wán le
items.en: The teacher has handed out all the test papers.
items.why: Subject, 把, specific object, then verb with its result 完 and 了 at the end. The object cannot follow 发完.

items.src: 小王把这份文件打印出来了。
items.src_py: xiǎo wáng bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn dǎ yìn chū lái le
items.zh: 小王应该把这份文件打印出来。
items.py: xiǎo wáng yīng gāi bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn dǎ yìn chū lái
items.en: Xiao Wang should print out this document.
items.why: 应该 goes before 把. The direction 出来 stays with the verb after the object.

items.q: 同事们把剩下的蛋糕吃___，一点儿也没留。
items.zh: 同事们把剩下的蛋糕吃了，一点儿也没留。
items.py: tóng shì men bǎ shèng xià de dàn gāo chī le yī diǎn r yě méi liú
items.en: My colleagues ate up the rest of the cake and left none.
items.why: 吃 uses up its object, so 把 plus verb plus 了 is a complete ending. A bare 吃 is not allowed after 把, and 着 and 过 do not describe finishing off the cake.

items.src_py: wǒ néng zuò wán zhè xiē zuò yè
items.zh: 我能把这些作业做完。
items.py: wǒ néng bǎ zhè xiē zuò yè zuò wán
items.en: I can get this homework done.
items.why: The modal 能 goes before 把, and the specific object goes in front of the verb 做完.

items.zh: 你听得懂老师的话吗？
items.py: nǐ tīng de dǒng lǎo shī de huà ma
items.en: Can you understand what the teacher says?
items.why: 听得懂 is a potential complement, which never takes 把. The object can follow the verb or be moved to the front as a topic.

items.q: 同事把我送___地铁站，然后就回去了。
items.zh: 同事把我送到地铁站，然后就回去了。
items.py: tóng shì bǎ wǒ sòng dào dì tiě zhàn rán hòu jiù huí qù le
items.en: My colleague saw me off to the subway station and then went back.
items.why: 送 plus 到 gives the place someone is taken to. 送在 does not exist, 送给 needs a person, and 送成 means turning into something else.

items.src: 他把这个句子翻译成中文。
items.src_py: tā bǎ zhè ge jù zi fān yì chéng zhōng wén
items.zh: 他没把这个句子翻译成中文。
items.py: tā méi bǎ zhè ge jù zi fān yì chéng zhōng wén
items.en: He didn't translate this sentence into Chinese.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, and 翻译成 keeps the new form 中文 directly after it.

items.q: 小王把电脑拿___了，现在办公室里没有。
items.zh: 小王把电脑拿走了，现在办公室里没有。
items.py: xiǎo wáng bǎ diàn nǎo ná zǒu le xiàn zài bàn gōng shì lǐ méi yǒu
items.en: Xiao Wang took the computer away; it isn't in the office now.
items.why: 拿走 is the directional ending that fits 'taken away', matching the computer no longer being in the office. 拿完 and 拿对 do not make sense here.

items.q: 请你把办公桌擦___擦，上面有很多灰。
items.zh: 请你把办公桌擦一擦，上面有很多灰。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ bàn gōng zhuō cā yī cā shàng miàn yǒu hěn duō huī
items.en: Please give the desk a wipe; it's covered in dust.
items.why: With no result or direction, the verb can be repeated as 擦一擦 to end the 把 clause. 不 and 没 would turn it into an A-not-A form, and 在 would mean 'is wiping'.

items.s: 我把作业没做完。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè méi zuò wán
items.zh: 我没把作业做完。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ zuò yè zuò wán
items.en: I didn't finish my homework.
items.why: 没 stands before 把, not between the object and the verb.

items.src_py: tóng xué cā gān jìng le hēi bǎn
items.zh: 同学把黑板擦干净了。
items.py: tóng xué bǎ hēi bǎn cā gān jìng le
items.en: The student wiped the blackboard clean.
items.why: 把 moves the blackboard in front of the verb, and 擦干净 keeps its result together with 了 at the end.

items.q: 上课的时候，___把手机放在桌子上。
items.zh: 上课的时候，别把手机放在桌子上。
items.py: shàng kè de shí hou bié bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: Don't leave your phone on the desk during class.
items.why: A prohibition is 别 placed before 把. 没 reports something that did not happen, and 不是 and 不会 do not give an instruction.

items.zh: 我想把这本书看完。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè běn shū kàn wán
items.en: I want to finish this book.
items.why: 想 stands before 把 and the object before the verb. 看完 keeps its result, and there is no 了 because it has not happened yet.

items.q: 妈妈把钥匙放___桌子上了。
items.zh: 妈妈把钥匙放在桌子上了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ yào shi fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.en: Mum put the keys on the table.
items.why: 放 + 在 + place says where the thing ends up, and the specific object goes in front of the verb with 把. 给 needs a person, 成 a new form and 走 a direction, so none of them fit 桌子上.

items.q: 请把这个包裹送___我家。
items.zh: 请把这个包裹送到我家。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè ge bāo guǒ sòng dào wǒ jiā
items.en: Please deliver this parcel to my home.
items.why: 送 moves something to a destination, so 到 follows it. 送在 is not a word, and 成 / 作 mean 'turn into' or 'treat as', not 'deliver to'.

items.q: 姐姐把那件旧毛衣送___了邻居。
items.zh: 姐姐把那件旧毛衣送给了邻居。
items.py: jiě jie bǎ nà jiàn jiù máo yī sòng gěi le lín jū
items.en: My sister gave that old sweater to the neighbour.
items.why: The neighbour is the person who receives it, so 送给 is needed. 送到了邻居 would need a place word such as 家 after it, and 在 and 成 do not fit a recipient.

items.q: 他把那张一百块换___了零钱。
items.zh: 他把那张一百块换成了零钱。
items.py: tā bǎ nà zhāng yī bǎi kuài huàn chéng le líng qián
items.en: He changed that hundred-yuan note into small change.
items.why: 换成 + new form means 'change into'. 给 would need a person, and 作 / 在 do not follow 换 here. The specific note goes before the verb with 把.

items.q: 奶奶很疼我，一直把我当___自己的亲孙女。
items.zh: 奶奶很疼我，一直把我当作自己的亲孙女。
items.py: nǎi nai hěn téng wǒ yī zhí bǎ wǒ dàng zuò zì jǐ de qīn sūn nǚ
items.en: Grandma dotes on me and has always treated me as her own granddaughter.
items.why: 当作 means 'treat as' and needs 把 for the person being treated. 当在, 当到 and 当给 are not words.

items.q: 你把这杯牛奶喝___吧。
items.zh: 你把这杯牛奶喝了吧。
items.py: nǐ bǎ zhè bēi niú nǎi hē le ba
items.en: Drink up this glass of milk.
items.why: After 把 the verb cannot stand bare, and 喝 has no result here, so 了 is the minimal ending. 着 and 过 do not belong in a 把 command, and leaving the blank empty gives a bare verb.

items.q: 对不起，我把你的生日忘___。
items.zh: 对不起，我把你的生日忘了。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ bǎ nǐ de shēng rì wàng le
items.en: Sorry, I forgot your birthday.
items.why: 忘 is one of the verbs that can end in 了 alone after 把, because the object is lost. A bare 忘 after 把 is incomplete, and 着 does not fit a finished event.

items.q: 家里放不下了，你把这些旧报纸卖___吧。
items.zh: 家里放不下了，你把这些旧报纸卖了吧。
items.py: jiā lǐ fàng bu xià le nǐ bǎ zhè xiē jiù bào zhǐ mài le ba
items.en: There's no room at home; go and sell these old newspapers.
items.why: 卖 removes the newspapers, so 了 alone completes the 把 phrase. Without 了 the verb is bare, and 着 / 过 do not make an instruction.

items.q: 客人马上就到，请你把桌子擦___。
items.zh: 客人马上就到，请你把桌子擦一下。
items.py: kè rén mǎ shàng jiù dào qǐng nǐ bǎ zhuō zi cā yī xià
items.en: The guests are about to arrive; please give the table a wipe.
items.why: A request with no stated result needs 一下 (or 擦一擦) after the verb. 着, 过 and 的 cannot close a 把 request, and a bare 擦 is not allowed.

items.q: 妈妈，我___把钥匙带来。
items.zh: 妈妈，我没把钥匙带来。
items.py: mā ma wǒ méi bǎ yào shi dài lái
items.en: Mum, I didn't bring the keys.
items.why: An event that did not happen is negated with 没, placed before 把. 不 would be used for attitudes, 别 is a command, and 未 is not used in speech.

items.q: ___把玩具扔在地上！
items.zh: 别把玩具扔在地上！
items.py: bié bǎ wán jù rēng zài dì shàng
items.en: Don't throw your toys on the floor!
items.why: 'Don't' is 别 (or 不要), and it stands before 把. 没 is for things that did not happen, and 不是 / 不会 do not make commands.

items.q: 钱不多了，你___把钱花完。
items.zh: 钱不多了，你不要把钱花完。
items.py: qián bù duō le nǐ bù yào bǎ qián huā wán
items.en: There's not much money left; don't spend it all.
items.why: A warning not to do something uses 不要 before 把. 没 / 没有 report a past non-event, and 已经 would say it has already been spent, which contradicts the English.

items.q: 我想___这个玩具送给弟弟。
items.zh: 我想把这个玩具送给弟弟。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè ge wán jù sòng gěi dì di
items.en: I want to give this toy to my younger brother.
items.why: 送给 + person with a specific object needs 把 to bring the toy before the verb. 被 would make the toy the actor, and 跟 / 对 do not introduce the thing being given.

items.q: 我把___块蛋糕吃完了。
items.zh: 我把那块蛋糕吃完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà kuài dàn gāo chī wán le
items.en: I ate up that piece of cake.
items.why: The object of 把 must be a specific thing, so 那 fits. 一, 两 and 几 introduce new counted objects, which stay after the verb without 把, and they do not match 'that piece'.

items.q: 爸爸把___旧电视卖了。
items.zh: 爸爸把家里那台旧电视卖了。
items.py: bà ba bǎ jiā lǐ nà tái jiù diàn shì mài le
items.en: Dad sold the old TV we had at home.
items.why: The 把 object is the identifiable TV, 家里那台. 一台, 几台 and 两台 are counted, new objects, and they would also contradict 'the old TV' in the English.

items.q: 我把那首歌听___了。
items.zh: 我把那首歌听完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà shǒu gē tīng wán le
items.en: I listened to that song all the way through.
items.why: 听完 gives a real result, so 把 is fine. 听见 is perception that does nothing to the song and cannot take 把, and 听着 / 听过 are not results.

items.q: 爸爸把窗户___开了。
items.zh: 爸爸把窗户打开了。
items.py: bà ba bǎ chuāng hu dǎ kāi le
items.en: Dad opened the window.
items.why: 把 needs a verb that does something to the window, such as 打开. 喜欢, 知道 and 是 do nothing to their object and never combine with 把.

items.q: 作业太多了，我今天怎么也做___这些作业。
items.zh: 作业太多了，我今天怎么也做不完这些作业。
items.py: zuò yè tài duō le wǒ jīn tiān zěn me yě zuò bu wán zhè xiē zuò yè
items.en: There's too much homework; I just can't finish this homework today.
items.why: 做不完 is a potential complement meaning 'cannot get it done', which keeps the object after the verb and never takes 把. 做得完 and 做完 say the opposite of the English.

items.q: 奶奶每天早上都___。
items.zh: 奶奶每天早上都喝一杯牛奶。
items.py: nǎi nai měi tiān zǎo shang dōu hē yī bēi niú nǎi
items.en: Grandma drinks a glass of milk every morning.
items.why: A habit with a new counted object ('a glass of milk') is plain SVO. 把 needs a specific object and an outcome, so 把一杯牛奶喝 is wrong.

items.q: 弟弟把我刚买的新手机___了，我气得说不出话来。
items.zh: 弟弟把我刚买的新手机弄坏了，我气得说不出话来。
items.py: dì di bǎ wǒ gāng mǎi de xīn shǒu jī nòng huài le wǒ qì de shuō bu chū huà lái
items.en: My little brother broke the new phone I'd just bought, and I was too angry to speak.
items.why: 把 needs the verb plus its result: 弄坏 says what became of the phone. A bare 弄 does not say anything happened to it, and 着 / 过 do not give a result.

items.q: 我在楼下，请你把伞带___。
items.zh: 我在楼下，请你把伞带下来。
items.py: wǒ zài lóu xià qǐng nǐ bǎ sǎn dài xià lái
items.en: I'm downstairs; please bring the umbrella down to me.
items.why: The umbrella moves down towards the speaker, so 下来. 下去 would be away from the speaker, and 上来 / 上去 go up. The whole direction stays after the verb.

items.q: 他把那把椅子搬___了。
items.zh: 他把那把椅子搬走了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà bǎ yǐ zi bān zǒu le
items.en: He carried that chair away.
items.why: 搬走 puts a direction (away) after the verb, which satisfies 把. 着, 过 and 的 add no direction or result.

items.q: 孩子把玩具都带___学校去了。
items.zh: 孩子把玩具都带到学校去了。
items.py: hái zi bǎ wán jù dōu dài dào xué xiào qù le
items.en: The child took all the toys to school.
items.why: 带 + 到 + place marks the destination of a movement. 带在学校 would say where something rests, and 给 / 成 need a person or a new form.

items.q: 他___把我借给他的钱还给我，我有点儿着急。
items.zh: 他还没把我借给他的钱还给我，我有点儿着急。
items.py: tā hái méi bǎ wǒ jiè gěi tā de qián huán gěi wǒ wǒ yǒu diǎn r zháo jí
items.en: He still hasn't paid back the money I lent him, and I'm a bit anxious.
items.why: 'Has not yet' is 还没, before 把. 不 would say he refuses, 已经 says he has done it, and 不会 is a prediction. None of these match the worry in the second clause.

items.q: 这件外套已经不流行了，你把它___，再买一件新的吧。
items.zh: 这件外套已经不流行了，你把它卖掉，再买一件新的吧。
items.py: zhè jiàn wài tào yǐ jīng bù liú xíng le nǐ bǎ tā mài diào zài mǎi yī jiàn xīn de ba
items.en: This coat is out of fashion; sell it and buy a new one.
items.why: 卖掉 gives the verb a result, which 把 needs. A bare 卖 is not allowed after 把, and 着 / 过 do not fit an instruction.

items.zh: 爸爸把桌子搬进去了。
items.py: bà ba bǎ zhuō zi bān jìn qù le
items.en: Dad carried the table inside.
items.why: The object 桌子 goes right after 把, and the verb with its whole direction 搬进去 follows as one block, then 了.

items.zh: 我把书包放在沙发上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ shū bāo fàng zài shā fā shàng le
items.en: I put my school bag on the sofa.
items.why: 放在 + place needs the specific object moved forward with 把. 了 may sit after the place or right after 放在, but the bag cannot follow the verb.

items.zh: 我没把钱带来。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ qián dài lái
items.en: I didn't bring the money.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, and 带来 closes the phrase with no 了. 我把钱没带来 puts the negator in the wrong place.

items.zh: 别把牛奶洒在地上。
items.py: bié bǎ niú nǎi sǎ zài dì shàng
items.en: Don't spill the milk on the floor.
items.why: 别 stands before 把, then the object, then 洒在 + place. The negative cannot go between the object and the verb.

items.zh: 你可以把车停在门口。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chē tíng zài mén kǒu
items.en: You can park the car at the door.
items.why: The modal 可以 goes before 把, never after the object. 停在门口 stays together as the verb and its destination.

items.zh: 奶奶把碗洗干净了。
items.py: nǎi nai bǎ wǎn xǐ gān jìng le
items.en: Grandma washed the bowls clean.
items.why: 把 + object comes first, then verb + result 洗干净 kept together, then 了. The result cannot be separated from the verb.

items.zh: 请把这封信交给爸爸。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jiāo gěi bà ba
items.en: Please hand this letter to Dad.
items.why: 交给 + person with a specific object needs 把, and 请 comes first. The letter cannot follow 交给 here.

items.zh: 我想把房间打扫干净。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo gān jìng
items.en: I want to get the room properly clean.
items.why: 想 is a modal and stands before 把. The verb keeps its result 干净, and there is no 了 because it has not happened yet.

items.zh: 我把钱包忘在商店里了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ qián bāo wàng zài shāng diàn lǐ le
items.en: I left my wallet in the shop.
items.why: 忘在 + place with a specific object needs 把. The wallet goes before the verb, and 了 can come after the place or after 忘在.

items.zh: 姐姐把我的自行车骑走了。
items.py: jiě jie bǎ wǒ de zì xíng chē qí zǒu le
items.en: My sister rode off on my bike.
items.why: The possessed object 我的自行车 is specific and goes after 把. 骑走 keeps the verb and direction together, with 了 last.

items.zh: 哥哥已经把票买好了。
items.py: gē ge yǐ jīng bǎ piào mǎi hǎo le
items.en: My older brother has already bought the tickets.
items.why: The time adverb 已经 goes before 把, not between the object and the verb. 买好 keeps its result, then 了.

items.zh: 他没把那件衣服退回去。
items.py: tā méi bǎ nà jiàn yī fu tuì huí qù
items.en: He didn't take that garment back.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, and the direction 退回去 stays whole after the verb. After 没 there is no 了.

items.zh: 请你把这些菜放进冰箱里。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè xiē cài fàng jìn bīng xiāng lǐ
items.en: Please put these vegetables in the fridge.
items.why: 放进 + place needs the specific object before the verb with 把. 这些菜 cannot be left after 放进.

items.zh: 售货员把东西装进袋子里了。
items.py: shòu huò yuán bǎ dōng xi zhuāng jìn dài zi lǐ le
items.en: The shop assistant put the things in the bag.
items.why: 装进 + place moves the goods into the bag, so they go before the verb with 把. 了 may follow the place or 装进.

items.zh: 妈妈把这笔钱存进了银行。
items.py: mā ma bǎ zhè bǐ qián cún jìn le yín háng
items.en: Mum put this sum of money into the bank.
items.why: The specific sum goes after 把 and before 存进 + destination. 了 can come after 存进 or at the end.

items.zh: 我们应该把旧衣服送给邻居。
items.py: wǒ men yīng gāi bǎ jiù yī fu sòng gěi lín jū
items.en: We should give the old clothes to the neighbour.
items.why: 应该 is a modal and goes before 把. 送给 + person comes after the object.

items.zh: 老师把我们当作自己的孩子。
items.py: lǎo shī bǎ wǒ men dàng zuò zì jǐ de hái zi
items.en: The teacher treats us as her own children.
items.why: 当作 must be followed straight away by what the object is treated as, so 我们 goes after 把 and in front of the verb.

items.zh: 妈妈还没把菜洗好。
items.py: mā ma hái méi bǎ cài xǐ hǎo
items.en: Mum hasn't finished washing the vegetables yet.
items.why: 还没 goes before 把, and 洗好 keeps its result. After 没 there is no 了.

items.zh: 你把价钱再说一遍。
items.py: nǐ bǎ jià qián zài shuō yī biàn
items.en: Say the price once more.
items.why: The verb is not bare because 一遍 follows it. 价钱 goes after 把, and 再说 stays together before the number of times.

items.zh: 我一直把他当作自己的弟弟。
items.py: wǒ yī zhí bǎ tā dàng zuò zì jǐ de dì di
items.en: I've always treated him like my own younger brother.
items.why: 一直 goes before 把, and 当作 must be followed straight away by what he is treated as. 他 cannot come after the verb.

items.zh: 爸爸打算把旧房子卖掉，再买一套新的。
items.py: bà ba dǎ suàn bǎ jiù fáng zi mài diào zài mǎi yī tào xīn de
items.en: Dad plans to sell the old house and buy a new one.
items.why: 打算 stands before 把. 卖掉 supplies a result, and the new, counted object 一套新的 stays after its own verb 买 without 把.

items.zh: 你千万别把发票弄丢了。
items.py: nǐ qiān wàn bié bǎ fā piào nòng diū le
items.en: Whatever you do, don't lose the receipt.
items.why: 千万别 goes before 把, and 弄丢了 keeps the result 丢 attached to the verb. The receipt cannot sit after 弄丢了.

items.zh: 老板把那些便宜的东西摆在了门口。
items.py: lǎo bǎn bǎ nà xiē pián yi de dōng xi bǎi zài le mén kǒu
items.en: The shop owner put those cheap goods at the entrance.
items.why: 摆在 + place with a specific object needs 把. 了 may come after 摆在 or at the end, but the goods cannot follow the verb.

items.zh: 妈妈没把我买的东西放进冰箱里。
items.py: mā ma méi bǎ wǒ mǎi de dōng xi fàng jìn bīng xiāng lǐ
items.en: Mum didn't put the things I bought into the fridge.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, and the whole phrase 我买的东西 is the specific object. 放进冰箱里 stays together and takes no 了.

items.src_py: wǒ hē wán le nà bēi niú nǎi
items.zh: 我把那杯牛奶喝完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà bēi niú nǎi hē wán le
items.en: I finished that glass of milk.
items.why: 把 moves the specific object in front of the verb, and the verb keeps its result 完 and 了.

items.src: 妈妈洗干净了我的衣服。
items.src_py: mā ma xǐ gān jìng le wǒ de yī fu
items.zh: 妈妈把我的衣服洗干净了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ wǒ de yī fu xǐ gān jìng le
items.en: Mum washed my clothes clean.
items.why: The object 我的衣服 moves between 把 and the verb. The verb stays glued to its result 干净 and 了 comes last.

items.src_py: tā bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.zh: 他没把书放在桌子上。
items.py: tā méi bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: He didn't put the book on the table.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, and 了 is dropped because 没 already says the action did not happen.

items.src_py: qǐng nǐ guān mén
items.zh: 请你把门关上。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ mén guān shàng
items.en: Please close the door.
items.why: With 把 the door goes before the verb, and the verb needs a result such as 上. A request takes no 了.

items.src_py: tā bǎ nà wǎn tāng hē wán le
items.zh: 他喝完了那碗汤。
items.py: tā hē wán le nà wǎn tāng
items.en: He finished that bowl of soup.
items.why: With a specific object and a simple result both orders are correct. Without 把 the order is verb + result + 了 + object.

items.src_py: gē ge dǎ pò le bēi zi
items.zh: 哥哥把杯子打破了。
items.py: gē ge bǎ bēi zi dǎ pò le
items.en: My older brother broke the cup.
items.why: The cup moves in front of the verb, and 打破 keeps its result. 了 comes last.

items.src_py: qǐng ná chū nǐ de shū
items.zh: 请把你的书拿出来。
items.py: qǐng bǎ nǐ de shū ná chū lái
items.en: Please take your book out.
items.why: With 把 the object goes before the verb and the whole direction 拿出来 follows it. The object cannot be placed inside the direction.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ xiāng zi fàng zài mén kǒu
items.zh: 你可以把箱子放在门口。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ xiāng zi fàng zài mén kǒu
items.en: You can put the box at the door.
items.why: The modal 可以 goes before 把. Putting it after the object (你把箱子可以放在门口) is wrong.

items.src_py: tā méi bǎ qián bāo dài lái
items.zh: 他把钱包带来了。
items.py: tā bǎ qián bāo dài lái le
items.en: He brought his wallet.
items.why: Dropping 没 turns the event into a completed one, so 了 is added after the verb phrase.

items.src_py: yé ye rēng le nà ge jiù bāo
items.zh: 爷爷把那个旧包扔了。
items.py: yé ye bǎ nà ge jiù bāo rēng le
items.en: Grandpa threw that old bag away.
items.why: 扔 removes the object, so 了 alone can end the 把 phrase. The specific bag goes before the verb.

items.src_py: bà ba bǎ mén suǒ shàng le
items.zh: 爸爸没把门锁上。
items.py: bà ba méi bǎ mén suǒ shàng
items.en: Dad didn't lock the door.
items.why: 没 stands before 把, and 了 is dropped. The result 上 stays attached to the verb.

items.src_py: wǒ sòng gěi tā nà běn shū
items.zh: 我把那本书送给他。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū sòng gěi tā
items.en: I gave him that book.
items.why: 送给 + person with a specific object goes with 把: the book moves in front of the verb and the recipient follows 送给.

items.src: 妈妈把钥匙放在包里了。
items.src_py: mā ma bǎ yào shi fàng zài bāo lǐ le

items.py: bié bǎ yào shi fàng zài bāo lǐ
items.en: Don't put the keys in the bag.
items.why: 别 goes before 把, and a command takes no 了.

items.src: 他把这篇文章翻译成了英文。
items.src_py: tā bǎ zhè piān wén zhāng fān yì chéng le yīng wén
items.zh: 他没把这篇文章翻译成英文。
items.py: tā méi bǎ zhè piān wén zhāng fān yì chéng yīng wén
items.en: He didn't translate this article into English.
items.why: 没 goes before 把 and 了 disappears. 翻译成 stays directly in front of the new form 英文.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ lǐ wù mǎi hǎo le
items.task: Say 'I have already ...' with 已经.

items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ lǐ wù mǎi hǎo le
items.en: I've already bought the presents.
items.why: 已经 goes before 把, never between the object and the verb. 买好 and 了 stay at the end.

items.src_py: qǐng bǎ yī fu guà zài mén hòu miàn
items.task: Say that he did it (他 ... 了).
items.zh: 他把衣服挂在门后面了。
items.py: tā bǎ yī fu guà zài mén hòu miàn le
items.en: He hung the clothes behind the door.
items.why: The statement keeps 把 + object + 挂在 + place. 了 can come after the place or after 挂在.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ nà xiē jiù shū mài le
items.zh: 我想把那些旧书卖了。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ nà xiē jiù shū mài le
items.en: I want to sell those old books.
items.why: 想 is a modal and goes before 把. 卖了 can still end the phrase because selling removes the object.

items.src_py: gē ge bǎ chē jiè gěi le péng you
items.zh: 哥哥没把车借给朋友。
items.py: gē ge méi bǎ chē jiè gěi péng you
items.en: My brother didn't lend the car to a friend.
items.why: 没 goes before 把 and the 了 is dropped. 借给 + person stays after the object.

items.src: 弟弟把我的蛋糕吃完了。

items.zh: 弟弟吃完了我的蛋糕。
items.py: dì di chī wán le wǒ de dàn gāo
items.en: My little brother finished my cake.
items.why: A specific object with a simple result allows both orders. Without 把 the object follows 吃完了.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān xǐ le sān jiàn yī fu
items.task: Now say 'I washed those clothes clean', with 把.
items.zh: 我把那些衣服洗干净了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà xiē yī fu xǐ gān jìng le
items.en: I washed those clothes clean.
items.why: The source has a new counted object after the verb. Once the object is specific (那些衣服) it can go after 把, with the result 干净 and 了.

items.src_py: wǒ men bǎ jiù diàn shì bān zǒu ba

items.py: wǒ men bǎ jiù diàn shì bān zǒu le

items.why: Replace the suggestion 吧 with 了 to report it as done. The direction 走 stays with the verb.

items.src_py: tā bǎ wǒ de míng zi xiě cuò le

items.py: tā méi bǎ wǒ de míng zi xiě cuò
items.en: He didn't write my name wrong.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ qián huán gěi tā le

items.py: wǒ hái méi bǎ qián huán gěi tā
items.en: I haven't paid him back yet.

items.src: 妈妈把买来的水果切好了。

items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ mǎi lái de shuǐ guǒ qiē hǎo
items.en: Please cut up the fruit that was bought.
items.why: A request keeps 把 + object + verb + result but drops 了, since nothing has happened yet.

items.src: 我昨天没把那张发票带回家。

items.en: Don't forget to take that receipt home.

items.src: 老师把我们的作业都改完了。

items.task: Say it has not happened yet with 还没.
items.zh: 老师还没把我们的作业都改完。
items.py: lǎo shī hái méi bǎ wǒ men de zuò yè dōu gǎi wán
items.en: The teacher hasn't finished marking all our homework yet.
items.why: 还没 goes before 把, and 都 stays after the object, where it sums it up. 了 is dropped.

items.src: 他打算把这些旧家具卖给邻居。
items.src_py: tā dǎ suàn bǎ zhè xiē jiù jiā jù mài gěi lín jū

items.py: tā yǐ jīng bǎ zhè xiē jiù jiā jù mài gěi lín jū le
items.en: He has already sold this old furniture to the neighbour.
items.why: 已经 replaces 打算 and goes before 把. 了 can follow 邻居 or follow 卖给.

items.src: 你应该把这个价钱告诉妈妈。

items.en: Don't tell Mum this price.
items.why: 不要 replaces 应该 and stays before 把.

items.src: 他们把那个小房间当作书房。

items.py: tā men yī zhí bǎ nà ge xiǎo fáng jiān dàng zuò shū fáng
items.en: They have always used that small room as a study.
items.why: 一直 goes before 把. 当作 stays directly in front of what the room is treated as.

items.s: 哥哥把那碗饭吃。

items.s: 我把这件旧衣服想卖掉。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn jiù yī fu xiǎng mài diào

items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè jiàn jiù yī fu mài diào
items.en: I want to sell this old coat.
items.why: The modal 想 goes before 把, not between the object and the verb.

items.s: 老师翻译这个词成英文了。
items.s_py: lǎo shī fān yì zhè ge cí chéng yīng wén le
items.zh: 老师把这个词翻译成英文了。
items.py: lǎo shī bǎ zhè ge cí fān yì chéng yīng wén le
items.en: The teacher translated this word into English.
items.why: 翻译成 must be followed straight away by the new form 英文, so the word translated has to go in front of the verb with 把.

items.s: 你把书可以放在床上。
items.s_py: nǐ bǎ shū kě yǐ fàng zài chuáng shàng
items.zh: 你可以把书放在床上。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ shū fàng zài chuáng shàng
items.en: You can put the book on the bed.
items.why: The modal 可以 goes before 把. Between the object and the verb is wrong.

items.s: 我把这个包很喜欢。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge bāo hěn xǐ huan
items.zh: 我很喜欢这个包。
items.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè ge bāo
items.en: I really like this bag.
items.why: 喜欢 does nothing to its object, so it cannot take 把.

items.s: 请把拿钱出来。
items.s_py: qǐng bǎ ná qián chū lái
items.zh: 请把钱拿出来。
items.py: qǐng bǎ qián ná chū lái
items.en: Please take the money out.
items.why: The object comes directly after 把, and the verb with its whole direction follows. 拿钱出来 cuts the verb away from its object.

items.s: 妈妈把我看见了。
items.s_py: mā ma bǎ wǒ kàn jiàn le
items.zh: 妈妈看见我了。
items.py: mā ma kàn jiàn wǒ le
items.en: Mum saw me.
items.why: 看见 only registers something and does nothing to it, so it takes plain SVO, not 把.

items.s: 我昨天把一件外套买了。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ yī jiàn wài tào mǎi le

items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī jiàn wài tào

items.s: 我把这些衣服洗不干净。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè xiē yī fu xǐ bu gān jìng

items.en: I can't get these clothes clean.

items.s: 你把我的手机能还给我吗？
items.s_py: nǐ bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī néng huán gěi wǒ ma
items.zh: 你能把我的手机还给我吗？
items.py: nǐ néng bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī huán gěi wǒ ma
items.en: Can you give my phone back to me?
items.why: The modal 能 goes before 把, not after the object. 还给 + person then follows the specific object 我的手机.

items.s: 我把这件事早就知道了。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn shì zǎo jiù zhī dào le

items.py: wǒ zǎo jiù zhī dào zhè jiàn shì le
items.en: I've known about this for ages.
