items.s: 我把妈妈的话忘了。
items.zh: 我把妈妈的话忘了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ mā ma de huà wàng le
items.en: I forgot what Mum said.
items.why: 忘 looks like a mental verb, but it is one of the exceptions: the thing is lost, and 了 is enough after 把.

items.s: 她把那条旧裙子卖了。
items.zh: 她把那条旧裙子卖了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà tiáo jiù qún zi mài le
items.en: She sold that old skirt.
items.why: 卖 gets rid of the skirt, so 了 alone is a sufficient ending after 把. The skirt is specific (那条).

items.s: 我把价格看清楚了。
items.zh: 我把价格看清楚了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ jià gé kàn qīng chu le
items.en: I've read the price properly.
items.why: 看 takes 把 when a real result such as 清楚 follows. Only bare perception like 看见 is excluded.

items.s: 你把这些旧杂志扔了吧。
items.zh: 你把这些旧杂志扔了吧。
items.py: nǐ bǎ zhè xiē jiù zá zhì rēng le ba
items.en: Throw out these old magazines.
items.why: 扔 removes the object, so 了 completes the phrase even in a suggestion, and 这些 makes the object specific.

items.s: 我昨天买了两条围巾。
items.zh: 我昨天买了两条围巾。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le liǎng tiáo wéi jīn
items.en: I bought two scarves yesterday.
items.why: 'Two scarves' is new and counted, so plain SVO is correct. 把 would be wrong here, so the absence of 把 is not an error.

items.s: 妹妹把我的面包吃了一半。
items.zh: 妹妹把我的面包吃了一半。
items.py: mèi mei bǎ wǒ de miàn bāo chī le yī bàn
items.en: My little sister ate half of my bread.
items.why: The object 我的面包 is specific, and 一半 after the verb counts as the extra element. 把 is fine.

items.s: 你不把作业做完，就不能看电视。
items.zh: 你不把作业做完，就不能看电视。
items.py: nǐ bù bǎ zuò yè zuò wán jiù bù néng kàn diàn shì
items.en: If you don't finish your homework, you can't watch TV.
items.why: 不 before 把 is correct in a condition or attitude like this. Only a past event that did not happen must use 没把.

items.s: 别把钱包放在口袋里。
items.zh: 别把钱包放在口袋里。
items.py: bié bǎ qián bāo fàng zài kǒu dai lǐ
items.en: Don't put your wallet in your pocket.
items.why: 别 goes before 把, and 放在 + place completes the phrase. A command like this takes no 了.

items.s: 我还没把买衣服的钱交给妈妈。
items.zh: 我还没把买衣服的钱交给妈妈。
items.py: wǒ hái méi bǎ mǎi yī fu de qián jiāo gěi mā ma
items.en: I still haven't handed Mum the money for the clothes.
items.why: 还没 stands before 把, and 交给 + person follows the specific object 买衣服的钱. There is no 了 after 没.

items.zh: 请把这张纸交给医生。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng zhǐ jiāo gěi yī shēng
items.en: Please hand this sheet of paper to the doctor.
items.why: 交给 + person with a specific object takes 把 first: 请把这张纸交给医生. The object cannot be placed after 交给 because that slot is the recipient.

items.zh: 爸爸把雨靴洗干净了。
items.py: bà ba bǎ yǔ xuē xǐ gān jìng le
items.en: Dad washed the rain boots clean.
items.why: 把 puts the object 雨靴 before the verb, and 洗干净 keeps its result together with 了 last. 把 cannot come after the verb.

items.s: 冬天我每天早上都喝一杯热水。
items.zh: 冬天我每天早上都喝一杯热水。
items.py: dōng tiān wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang dōu hē yī bēi rè shuǐ
items.en: In winter I drink a cup of hot water every morning.
items.why: A habit with a counted object needs plain SVO; 把 would be wrong, so this sentence is correct.

items.s: 你把手套可以戴上。
items.zh: 你可以把手套戴上。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ shǒu tào dài shàng
items.en: You can put the gloves on.
items.why: The modal 可以 goes before 把, never between the object and the verb.
items.s_py: nǐ bǎ shǒu tào kě yǐ dài shàng

items.src_py: tā zhī dào míng tiān huì xià xuě
items.task: Say he doesn't know yet (还不).
items.zh: 他还不知道明天会下雪。
items.py: tā hái bù zhī dào míng tiān huì xià xuě
items.en: He doesn't know yet that it will snow tomorrow.
items.why: 知道 is a knowing verb and takes no 把; 还不 simply goes in front of it.

items.s: 他翻译这句话成英文了。
items.zh: 他把这句话翻译成英文了。
items.py: tā bǎ zhè jù huà fān yì chéng yīng wén le
items.en: He translated this sentence into English.
items.why: 翻译成 must be followed directly by 英文, so the sentence has to move before the verb with 把.
items.s_py: tā fān yì zhè jù huà chéng yīng wén le

items.q: 他把___帽子戴上就出门了，外面正下着雪。
items.zh: 他把自己的帽子戴上就出门了，外面正下着雪。
items.py: tā bǎ zì jǐ de mào zi dài shàng jiù chū mén le wài miàn zhèng xià zhe xuě
items.en: He put on his own hat and went out; it was snowing outside.
items.why: 自己的 makes the hat specific and identifiable, which 把 requires, and it matches 'his own hat'. 两顶, 几顶 and 一些 give a new quantity of hats, which does not fit the cue.

items.s: 你可以把空调关小一点儿。
items.zh: 你可以把空调关小一点儿。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ kōng tiáo guān xiǎo yī diǎn r
items.en: You can turn the aircon down a bit.
items.why: 可以 stands before 把, and 关小一点儿 supplies a result, so the sentence is complete.

items.s: 你把汤喝。
items.zh: 你把汤喝了。
items.py: nǐ bǎ tāng hē le
items.en: Drink up the soup.
items.why: A 把 sentence cannot end on a bare verb. 了 is the minimum.
items.s_py: nǐ bǎ tāng hē

items.q: 雨水把我的鞋都弄___了。
items.zh: 雨水把我的鞋都弄湿了。
items.py: yǔ shuǐ bǎ wǒ de xié dōu nòng shī le
items.en: The rain got all my shoes wet.
items.why: 弄 needs a result that names the new state of the shoes, and only 湿 does that. 着, 过 and 到 cannot follow 弄 to say what condition the shoes ended up in.

items.q: 我的嗓子太疼了，这碗饭我吃___完。
items.zh: 我的嗓子太疼了，这碗饭我吃不完。
items.py: wǒ de sǎng zi tài téng le zhè wǎn fàn wǒ chī bù wán
items.en: My throat hurts so much that I can't finish this bowl of rice.
items.why: 吃不完 is a potential complement saying the result cannot be reached, which fits the sore throat and never combines with 把. 得 would claim he can finish, and 没 cannot sit inside the verb.

items.q: 我把药吃___了，现在不疼了。
items.zh: 我把药吃完了，现在不疼了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ yào chī wán le xiàn zài bù téng le
items.en: I've taken all my medicine, and it doesn't hurt now.
items.why: After 把 the verb needs a result, and 完 says the medicine is used up. 过 means 'have done it before' and 着 a continuing state, so neither gives the finished outcome that 了 and 不疼了 point to.

items.src_py: nǐ bǎ zhè píng shuǐ jiāo gěi bìng rén
items.task: Make it a polite request with 请.
items.zh: 请把这瓶水交给病人。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè píng shuǐ jiāo gěi bìng rén
items.en: Please hand this bottle of water to the patient.
items.why: A polite request starts with 请, which replaces the subject 你, and 把 follows straight after it.

items.src_py: wǒ hē wán le nà bēi rè chá
items.zh: 我把那杯热茶喝完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà bēi rè chá hē wán le
items.en: I finished that cup of hot tea.
items.why: The specific object 那杯热茶 can go after 把, and the verb keeps 完 and 了.

items.q: 我感冒了，鼻子堵得厉害，什么味道都闻___。
items.zh: 我感冒了，鼻子堵得厉害，什么味道都闻不到。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le bí zi dǔ de lì hai shén me wèi dào dōu wén bù dào
items.en: I have a cold and my nose is so blocked that I can't smell anything.
items.why: A blocked nose means the smell cannot be reached, so the potential form 闻不到 is needed. 闻得到 says the opposite, and 没到 or 把到 are not forms a native would produce here.

items.zh: 我在医院门口看见他了。
items.py: wǒ zài yī yuàn mén kǒu kàn jiàn tā le
items.en: I saw him at the hospital entrance.
items.why: 看见 only perceives and does nothing to the object, so there is no 把; the object follows 看见 directly.

items.zh: 妈妈把我的外套洗干净了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ wǒ de wài tào xǐ gān jìng le
items.en: Mum washed my coat clean.
items.why: The specific object 我的外套 follows 把, then the verb with its result 洗干净, then 了. The result cannot be separated from the verb.

items.zh: 他把那瓶过期的药扔掉了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà píng guò qī de yào rēng diào le
items.en: He threw away that bottle of expired medicine.
items.why: 那瓶过期的药 is specific, so it can follow 把, and 扔掉了 gives the verb its result. The object cannot be left after 扔掉了.

items.src_py: tā bǎ nà wǎn zhōu hē wán le
items.task: Change it to 'two bowls of porridge' (no 把).
items.zh: 他喝完了两碗粥。
items.py: tā hē wán le liǎng wǎn zhōu
items.en: He finished two bowls of porridge.
items.why: A new counted object (两碗粥) is not specific, so it stays after the verb and 把 is dropped.

items.src_py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ fān yì zhè jù huà
items.task: Add 'into Chinese' (成中文) using 把.
items.zh: 老师让我把这句话翻译成中文。
items.py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ bǎ zhè jù huà fān yì chéng zhōng wén
items.en: The teacher told me to translate this sentence into Chinese.
items.why: 翻译成 + new form requires 把, so the sentence goes before the verb after 把.

items.zh: 他在公园里锻炼身体呢。
items.py: tā zài gōng yuán lǐ duàn liàn shēn tǐ ne
items.en: He's exercising in the park.
items.why: An action in progress has no result for the object, so plain SVO is used; 把 would be wrong without an outcome.

items.q: 外面下雪了，你把大衣穿___吧。
items.zh: 外面下雪了，你把大衣穿上吧。
items.py: wài miàn xià xuě le nǐ bǎ dà yī chuān shàng ba
items.en: It's snowing outside; put your coat on.
items.why: 穿上 is the direction/result complement for putting clothes on, and it must follow 穿 directly. 在 and 给 need a place or a person, 成 needs a new form, so none fit a coat.

items.src_py: fēng chuī kāi le chuāng hu
items.zh: 风把窗户吹开了。
items.py: fēng bǎ chuāng hu chuī kāi le
items.en: The wind blew the window open.
items.why: The object 窗户 goes between 把 and the verb, and 吹开 stays together with 了 at the end.

items.zh: 我没把伞带来。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ sǎn dài lái
items.en: I didn't bring my umbrella.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, never between the object and the verb. 我把伞没带来 is the classic mistake.

items.q: 他还___把退烧药吃下去，就睡着了。
items.zh: 他还没把退烧药吃下去，就睡着了。
items.py: tā hái méi bǎ tuì shāo yào chī xià qù jiù shuì zháo le
items.en: He fell asleep before he had even taken the fever medicine.
items.why: 还没 + 把 describes something not yet done, with the negator before 把. 不 does not report an event that did not happen, 别 is a command, and 要 contradicts 就睡着了.

items.zh: 我很喜欢夏天。
items.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan xià tiān
items.en: I really like summer.
items.why: 喜欢 never takes 把, so the object simply follows the verb (or is fronted as a topic).

items.q: 我把这个药的名字忘___，你能再说一遍吗？
items.zh: 我把这个药的名字忘了，你能再说一遍吗？
items.py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge yào de míng zi wàng le nǐ néng zài shuō yī biàn ma
items.en: I've forgotten the name of this medicine; could you say it again?
items.why: 忘 is one of the few mental verbs that take 把, and like other lost-object verbs it needs 了. A bare 忘 after 把 is not a complete sentence.

items.zh: 妈妈把我送到医院了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ wǒ sòng dào yī yuàn le
items.en: Mum took me to the hospital.
items.why: 送到 + place with a specific person moved: 把我 goes before 送到, and the destination follows. 了 may come after the place or right after 送到.

items.q: 我很喜欢___这个季节。
items.zh: 我很喜欢这个季节。
items.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè ge jì jié
items.en: I really like this season.
items.why: 喜欢 does nothing to its object, so it never takes 把; the object simply follows the verb. 对 would also not fit, since 喜欢 takes a direct object.

items.s: 护士把药放在了床头的桌子上。
items.zh: 护士把药放在了床头的桌子上。
items.py: hù shi bǎ yào fàng zài le chuáng tóu de zhuō zi shàng
items.en: The nurse put the medicine on the table by the bed.
items.why: 放在 + place with 了 after 在 is fine, and the object goes before the verb with 把.

items.src_py: nǐ xǐ yī xià shǒu ba
items.zh: 你把手洗一下吧。
items.py: nǐ bǎ shǒu xǐ yī xià ba
items.en: Give your hands a wash.
items.why: 把 moves 手 forward and the verb keeps 一下, which is enough to stop it being a bare verb.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ gǎn mào zhì hǎo le
items.task: Say you WANT to do it (想), a plan not yet done.
items.zh: 我想把感冒治好。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ gǎn mào zhì hǎo
items.en: I want to get my cold cured.
items.why: 想 goes before 把, and the final 了 is dropped because the plan has not happened yet.

items.zh: 医生要求他必须把烟戒掉。
items.py: yī shēng yāo qiú tā bì xū bǎ yān jiè diào
items.en: The doctor requires him to give up smoking.
items.why: The modal 必须 stands before 把 and the object 烟 goes ahead of 戒掉. 他把烟必须戒掉 puts the modal in the wrong place.

items.src_py: nǐ dài zǒu zhè xiē yào ba
items.zh: 你把这些药带走吧。
items.py: nǐ bǎ zhè xiē yào dài zǒu ba
items.en: Take these medicines with you.
items.why: The specific object 这些药 goes after 把, then 带走 as one block, then 吧.

items.s: 我把这么多水喝不完。
items.zh: 我喝不完这么多水。
items.py: wǒ hē bù wán zhè me duō shuǐ
items.en: I can't finish drinking this much water.
items.why: 喝不完 says the result cannot be reached, and a potential complement never combines with 把.
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè me duō shuǐ hē bù wán

items.s: 太阳很大，你把帽子戴上吧。
items.zh: 太阳很大，你把帽子戴上吧。
items.py: tài yáng hěn dà nǐ bǎ mào zi dài shàng ba
items.en: The sun is strong; put your hat on.
items.why: A specific hat and a direction/result 上 make 把 correct here.

items.src_py: tā hē le nà píng niú nǎi
items.zh: 他把那瓶牛奶喝了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà píng niú nǎi hē le
items.en: He drank that bottle of milk.
items.why: With 把 the verb cannot stay bare; 喝了 is enough because the milk is used up.

items.s: 我把药瓶上的字看清楚了。
items.zh: 我把药瓶上的字看清楚了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ yào píng shàng de zì kàn qīng chu le
items.en: I've made out the writing on the medicine bottle clearly.
items.why: 看 takes 把 when a real result like 清楚 follows. The result makes it a change in state, not mere perception.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ wéi jīn dài huí qù le
items.task: Say you did NOT do it.
items.zh: 我没把围巾带回去。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ wéi jīn dài huí qù
items.en: I didn't take the scarf back.
items.why: 没 goes before 把 and 了 is dropped, because 没 already says it did not happen.

items.zh: 他把晒干的衣服收进来了。
items.py: tā bǎ shài gān de yī fu shōu jìn lái le
items.en: He brought the dried clothes in.
items.why: The object 晒干的衣服 stands between 把 and the verb, and the full direction 收进来 follows the verb as one block, with 了 last.

items.q: 我把___碗姜汤喝完了，现在不冷了。
items.zh: 我把那碗姜汤喝完了，现在不冷了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà wǎn jiāng tāng hē wán le xiàn zài bù lěng le
items.en: I finished that bowl of ginger soup, and now I'm not cold.
items.why: The 把 object must be specific, and 那 makes it 'that bowl'. 几, 许多 and 两 give new quantities, which stay after the verb and would not match the cue 'that bowl'.

items.s: 他把这个消息知道了。
items.zh: 他知道这个消息了。
items.py: tā zhī dào zhè ge xiāo xi le
items.en: He knows this news now.
items.why: 知道 is a knowing verb and never takes 把.
items.s_py: tā bǎ zhè ge xiāo xi zhī dào le

items.zh: 他把天气预报翻译成了英文。
items.py: tā bǎ tiān qì yù bào fān yì chéng le yīng wén
items.en: He translated the weather forecast into English.
items.why: 翻译成 must be followed straight away by the new form 英文, so the thing translated goes before the verb with 把.

items.src_py: nǐ bǎ yào jiāo gěi hù shi le
items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
items.zh: 你把药交给护士了吗？
items.py: nǐ bǎ yào jiāo gěi hù shi le ma
items.en: Did you hand the medicine to the nurse?
items.why: Adding 吗 at the end turns the statement into a yes/no question; the 把 structure itself does not change.

items.zh: 我把帽子放在桌子上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ mào zi fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.en: I put my hat on the table.
items.why: 放在 + place wants the object in front of the verb, so 把帽子 comes before 放在桌子上. Leaving 帽子 after 放 is not the natural order for a specific object.

items.q: 你感冒了，___把这杯热水喝了再睡。
items.zh: 你感冒了，最好把这杯热水喝了再睡。
items.py: nǐ gǎn mào le zuì hǎo bǎ zhè bēi rè shuǐ hē le zài shuì
items.en: You've got a cold, so you'd better drink this hot water before bed.
items.why: 最好 is a modal-like adverb and stands before 把, giving advice. 别 would forbid the drink, which contradicts the advice, and 没 or 不 do not fit before 把 here.

items.src_py: tā bǎ mào zi dài dào xué xiào le
items.task: Turn it into a 了没有 question.
items.zh: 他把帽子带到学校了没有？
items.py: tā bǎ mào zi dài dào xué xiào le méi yǒu
items.en: Did he take his hat to school?
items.why: 了没有 at the end asks whether it happened; the 把 phrase and 带到学校 stay unchanged.

items.q: 我在屋里喊：下雨了，快把院子里的衣服收___！
items.zh: 我在屋里喊：下雨了，快把院子里的衣服收进来！
items.py: wǒ zài wū lǐ hǎn xià yǔ le kuài bǎ yuàn zi lǐ de yī fu shōu jìn lái
items.en: I shouted from inside the house, 'It's raining, quick, bring the washing in from the yard!'
items.why: The speaker is indoors, so the washing moves toward the speaker: 进来. 进去 would be right only if the speaker were outside; 出来 and 出去 mean moving out of the house.

items.src_py: mā ma ná chū máo jīn lái le
items.zh: 妈妈把毛巾拿出来了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ máo jīn ná chū lái le
items.en: Mum took out the towel.
items.why: With 把 the object goes before the verb and the whole direction 出来 follows 拿 as one block, not split around the object.

items.s: 我在门口把他看见了。
items.zh: 我在门口看见他了。
items.py: wǒ zài mén kǒu kàn jiàn tā le
items.en: I saw him at the door.
items.why: 看见 only reports perceiving someone and does not change him, so 把 cannot be used.
items.s_py: wǒ zài mén kǒu bǎ tā kàn jiàn le

items.zh: 我每天喝三杯水。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān hē sān bēi shuǐ
items.en: I drink three glasses of water every day.
items.why: A habit with a counted object is plain SVO. 把 needs a specific object and an outcome, neither of which is here.

items.src_py: tā bǎ gǎn mào dàng chéng xiǎo shì
items.task: Say he does NOT treat it that way (use 不).
items.zh: 他不把感冒当成小事。
items.py: tā bù bǎ gǎn mào dàng chéng xiǎo shì
items.en: He doesn't treat a cold as a trivial matter.
items.why: 把…当成 expresses an attitude, so it is negated with 不 before 把, with no 了. 没 would turn it into a single past event.

items.src: 奶奶从柜子里拿出了厚被子。
items.src_py: nǎi nai cóng guì zi lǐ ná chū le hòu bèi zi
items.zh: 奶奶把厚被子从柜子里拿出来了。
items.py: nǎi nai bǎ hòu bèi zi cóng guì zi lǐ ná chū lái le
items.en: Grandma took the thick quilt out of the cupboard.
items.why: The quilt is moved in front of the verb with 把, and 拿出来 stays whole. The 从 phrase may come before or after 把 + object.

items.q: 医生写的字太乱了，我看___懂。
items.zh: 医生写的字太乱了，我看不懂。
items.py: yī shēng xiě de zì tài luàn le wǒ kàn bù dǒng
items.en: The doctor's handwriting is so messy that I can't make it out.
items.why: 看不懂 is the potential complement 'unable to understand', which the messy handwriting calls for. 看得懂 would mean the opposite, and 看没懂 and 看把懂 are not forms.

items.s: 你把这碗中药喝了吧。
items.zh: 你把这碗中药喝了吧。
items.py: nǐ bǎ zhè wǎn zhōng yào hē le ba
items.en: Drink up this bowl of herbal medicine.
items.why: 喝了 is a valid ending after 把 because the medicine is used up, so this is not a bare verb.

items.zh: 你可以把空调关掉。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ kōng tiáo guān diào
items.en: You can turn off the aircon.
items.why: The modal 可以 goes before 把, not between the object and the verb. 你把空调可以关掉 is wrong.

items.zh: 你把脸擦一擦吧。
items.py: nǐ bǎ liǎn cā yī cā ba
items.en: Give your face a wipe.
items.why: A reduplicated verb is a valid ending for 把, so 擦一擦 completes the sentence. 把脸擦 alone would be incomplete.

items.src_py: nǐ xǐ yī xià shāng kǒu
items.task: Rewrite with 把 and a reduplicated verb (洗一洗).
items.zh: 你把伤口洗一洗。
items.py: nǐ bǎ shāng kǒu xǐ yī xǐ
items.en: Give the wound a wash.
items.why: Reduplication is a valid ending for 把 and replaces 一下: 把伤口洗一洗.

items.src_py: xuě yǐ jīng bǎ lù gài zhù le
items.task: Say it has NOT happened yet (还没).
items.zh: 雪还没把路盖住。
items.py: xuě hái méi bǎ lù gài zhù
items.en: The snow hasn't covered the road yet.
items.why: 还没 goes before 把, and 了 is dropped.

items.s: 请把拿出来伞。
items.zh: 请把伞拿出来。
items.py: qǐng bǎ sǎn ná chū lái
items.en: Please take your umbrella out.
items.why: The object must come directly after 把, and the verb with its direction follows as one block. 拿出来伞 puts the object in the wrong place.
items.s_py: qǐng bǎ ná chū lái sǎn

items.zh: 我在药店买了三盒感冒药。
items.py: wǒ zài yào diàn mǎi le sān hé gǎn mào yào
items.en: I bought three boxes of cold medicine at the pharmacy.
items.why: A new counted object (三盒感冒药) stays after the verb, so no 把. Using 把 here would need a specific, known object.

items.src: 弟弟把我的手表弄坏了。
items.src_py: dì di bǎ wǒ de shǒu biǎo nòng huài le
items.zh: 弟弟弄坏了我的手表。
items.py: dì di nòng huài le wǒ de shǒu biǎo
items.en: My little brother broke my watch.
items.why: A specific object with a simple result allows both orders, so the 把 sentence can go back to plain SVO with the result and 了 kept on the verb.

items.zh: 你把姜汤喝了吧。
items.py: nǐ bǎ jiāng tāng hē le ba
items.en: Drink up the ginger soup.
items.why: With no result, 了 is the minimum ending for 把 and fits 喝 because the soup is used up. A bare 喝 would be wrong after 把.

items.zh: 别把窗户打开。
items.py: bié bǎ chuāng hu dǎ kāi
items.en: Don't open the window.
items.why: 别 stands before 把, and the object comes before the verb. 把窗户别打开 puts 别 in the wrong place.

items.src: 我今天能把这些汤喝完。
items.src_py: wǒ jīn tiān néng bǎ zhè xiē tāng hē wán
items.task: Say you can't finish them (use 喝不完, no 把).
items.zh: 我今天喝不完这些汤。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān hē bù wán zhè xiē tāng
items.en: I can't finish this soup today.
items.why: Potential complements like 喝不完 never combine with 把, so the object goes after the verb.

items.q: 我早就知道___他生病了，只是没告诉你。
items.zh: 我早就知道他生病了，只是没告诉你。
items.py: wǒ zǎo jiù zhī dào tā shēng bìng le zhǐ shì méi gào su nǐ
items.en: I knew all along that he was ill; I just didn't tell you.
items.why: 知道 is a knowing verb and takes no 把; 他生病了 simply follows it. 被 would make no sense there and 把 cannot be used because nothing is done to him.

items.s: 我昨天买了一件厚外套。
items.zh: 我昨天买了一件厚外套。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī jiàn hòu wài tào
items.en: I bought a thick coat yesterday.
items.why: A new counted object (一件厚外套) stays after the verb; 把 would be wrong here, so this plain SVO sentence is correct.

items.zh: 他把湿透的毛衣脱了挂在椅子上。
items.py: tā bǎ shī tòu de máo yī tuō le guà zài yǐ zi shàng
items.en: He took off his soaked sweater and hung it on the chair.
items.why: The object goes before the first verb with 把, 脱了 ends the first step, and 挂在椅子上 follows. The sweater cannot stay after 脱.

items.q: 昨天路上我看见___他在雪地里摔倒了。
items.zh: 昨天路上我看见他在雪地里摔倒了。
items.py: zuó tiān lù shàng wǒ kàn jiàn tā zài xuě dì lǐ shuāi dǎo le
items.en: Yesterday on the road I saw him fall over in the snow.
items.why: 看见 only reports perceiving someone and does not change them, so it takes a plain object, not 把. 给 does not fit between 看见 and its object either.

items.q: 护士把病人送___了病房。
items.zh: 护士把病人送到了病房。
items.py: hù shi bǎ bìng rén sòng dào le bìng fáng
items.en: The nurse took the patient to the ward.
items.why: 送 moves someone to a place and takes 到 + destination. 送在 is not used for moving someone somewhere, and 成 and 当 mean turning into or treating as.

items.s: 我把医生的话忘了。
items.zh: 我把医生的话忘了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ yī shēng de huà wàng le
items.en: I forgot what the doctor said.
items.why: 忘 is the one mental verb that does take 把, with 了, because the thing is lost.

items.s: 我把这个坏消息告诉了医生。
items.zh: 我把这个坏消息告诉了医生。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge huài xiāo xi gào su le yī shēng
items.en: I told the doctor this bad news.
items.why: 告诉了 + person is a valid ending after 把 with a specific object.

items.s: 他没把门关好，所以屋里很冷。
items.zh: 他没把门关好，所以屋里很冷。
items.py: tā méi bǎ mén guān hǎo suǒ yǐ wū lǐ hěn lěng
items.en: He didn't close the door properly, so it's cold inside.
items.why: 没 before 把 with no 了 is exactly right for something not done.

items.src_py: wǒ kàn jiàn tā le
items.zh: 我没看见他。
items.py: wǒ méi kàn jiàn tā
items.en: I didn't see him.
items.why: 看见 does not take 把, so the negative is just 没 before the verb, and 了 is dropped.

items.zh: 请把伞带回去。
items.py: qǐng bǎ sǎn dài huí qù
items.en: Please take your umbrella back with you.
items.why: The object goes right after 把 and the whole directional verb 带回去 follows as one block. The object cannot sit inside or after 带回去.

items.q: 我___把体温计放回盒子里了。
items.zh: 我已经把体温计放回盒子里了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ tǐ wēn jì fàng huí hé zi lǐ le
items.en: I've already put the thermometer back in its box.
items.why: Time adverbs like 已经 go before 把, and they fit with the final 了. 没 would require dropping 了, 不 does not fit a finished action, and 别 is a command.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ dēng guān shàng
items.task: Say you will do it right away (马上).
items.zh: 我马上把灯关上。
items.py: wǒ mǎ shàng bǎ dēng guān shàng
items.en: I'll turn the light off right away.
items.why: 马上 stands before 把, not between the object and the verb.

items.src: 冬天的冷风吹红了她的脸。
items.src_py: dōng tiān de lěng fēng chuī hóng le tā de liǎn
items.zh: 冬天的冷风把她的脸吹红了。
items.py: dōng tiān de lěng fēng bǎ tā de liǎn chuī hóng le
items.en: The cold winter wind turned her face red.
items.why: 把 highlights what happened to her face: it is moved before the verb, and 吹红 plus 了 follow.

items.src_py: nǐ bǎ xuě rén duī zài mén kǒu
items.task: Tell him not to (start with 别).
items.zh: 别把雪人堆在门口。
items.py: bié bǎ xuě rén duī zài mén kǒu
items.en: Don't build the snowman at the door.
items.why: 别 goes before 把 and replaces the subject in the command.

items.s: 我把这场雪很喜欢。
items.zh: 我很喜欢这场雪。
items.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè chǎng xuě
items.en: I really like this snowfall.
items.why: 喜欢 does nothing to its object, so it never takes 把.
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè chǎng xuě hěn xǐ huan

items.zh: 雨一停我们就把自行车推出去了。
items.py: yǔ yī tíng wǒ men jiù bǎ zì xíng chē tuī chū qù le
items.en: As soon as the rain stopped, we pushed the bikes out.
items.why: The adverb 就 comes before 把, the bike goes between 把 and the verb, and 推出去 stays whole. 就 cannot go between the object and the verb.

items.q: 你的鞋湿了，快把鞋擦___。
items.zh: 你的鞋湿了，快把鞋擦一下。
items.py: nǐ de xié shī le kuài bǎ xié cā yī xià
items.en: Your shoes are wet; give them a quick wipe.
items.why: With no result or direction, 把 still needs something after the verb, and 一下 gives the action a light finish. A bare 擦 is wrong, and 着 or 过 do not fit a command.

items.src_py: tā cā gān jìng le yǎn jìng
items.zh: 他把眼镜擦干净了。
items.py: tā bǎ yǎn jìng cā gān jìng le
items.en: He wiped his glasses clean.
items.why: The object 眼镜 moves before the verb after 把, while 擦干净 and 了 stay together at the end.

items.src_py: wǒ dài lái le yǔ sǎn
items.zh: 我把雨伞带来了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ yǔ sǎn dài lái le
items.en: I've brought the umbrella.
items.why: The object goes after 把 and in front of the verb, and the direction 来 stays glued to 带.

items.q: 我___把药带来，所以今天没吃。
items.zh: 我没把药带来，所以今天没吃。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ yào dài lái suǒ yǐ jīn tiān méi chī
items.en: I didn't bring my medicine, so I haven't taken any today.
items.why: Something that did not happen is negated with 没, placed before 把. 不 does not describe a past event, 别 is a command, and 要 would say you will bring it.

items.q: 你把这个药交___医生吧。
items.zh: 你把这个药交给医生吧。
items.py: nǐ bǎ zhè ge yào jiāo gěi yī shēng ba
items.en: Hand this medicine over to the doctor.
items.why: 交给 + person is the pattern for handing something to someone, and the specific object goes before the verb with 把. 在 and 到 need a place, 成 a new form, so they do not fit 医生.

items.zh: 昨晚的大雪把院子里的树枝压断了。
items.py: zuó wǎn de dà xuě bǎ yuàn zi lǐ de shù zhī yā duàn le
items.en: Last night's heavy snow broke the branches in the yard.
items.why: The subject is the snow, 把 brings the branches before the verb, and 压断 (verb + result) stays together with 了 last. 把 cannot follow the verb.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ yǔ yī guà zài mén hòu le
items.zh: 我已经把雨衣挂在门后了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ yǔ yī guà zài mén hòu le
items.en: I've already hung the raincoat behind the door.
items.why: Time adverbs such as 已经 go before 把, never between the object and the verb.

items.q: 医生让我把这些药吃___。
items.zh: 医生让我把这些药吃了。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ bǎ zhè xiē yào chī le
items.en: The doctor told me to take all of this medicine.
items.why: A 把 sentence cannot end on a bare verb, and 吃 uses up the medicine, so 了 is enough. Leaving 吃 bare is wrong, and 过 or 着 do not say that the medicine gets finished.

items.src: 他把这些感冒药吃完了。
items.src_py: tā bǎ zhè xiē gǎn mào yào chī wán le
items.zh: 他吃完了这些感冒药。
items.py: tā chī wán le zhè xiē gǎn mào yào
items.en: He finished these cold tablets.
items.why: A specific object with a simple result allows both orders, so the 把 sentence can go back to plain SVO.

items.zh: 他看不懂这张药方。
items.py: tā kàn bù dǒng zhè zhāng yào fāng
items.en: He can't understand this prescription.
items.why: Potential complements like 看不懂 never combine with 把, so the object follows the verb (or is fronted as a topic).

items.q: 天很冷，你___把窗户开着睡觉。
items.zh: 天很冷，你别把窗户开着睡觉。
items.py: tiān hěn lěng nǐ bié bǎ chuāng hu kāi zhe shuì jiào
items.en: It's very cold, so don't sleep with the window open.
items.why: A prohibition is 别 placed before 把. 没 describes the past, and 要 or 会 would encourage the very thing the cold weather argues against.

items.src_py: nǐ bǎ chuāng hu kāi zhe
items.zh: 你可以把窗户开着。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chuāng hu kāi zhe
items.en: You can leave the window open.
items.why: The modal 可以 goes before 把, never between the object and the verb.

items.q: 雨太大了，他一进门就把湿衣服脱___。
items.zh: 雨太大了，他一进门就把湿衣服脱了。
items.py: yǔ tài dà le tā yī jìn mén jiù bǎ shī yī fu tuō le
items.en: The rain was so heavy that as soon as he came in he took off his wet clothes.
items.why: 脱 removes the clothes, so 了 alone is enough after 把. A bare 脱 at the end of the sentence is incomplete, and 着 or 过 would not describe a completed removal.

items.q: 护士把三十八度看___了三十度，所以没发现他发烧。
items.zh: 护士把三十八度看成了三十度，所以没发现他发烧。
items.py: hù shi bǎ sān shí bā dù kàn chéng le sān shí dù suǒ yǐ méi fā xiàn tā fā shāo
items.en: The nurse misread 38 degrees as 30 degrees, so she didn't notice he had a fever.
items.why: Misreading one thing as another is 看成, and the thing misread goes before the verb with 把. 看在 and 看给 are not words, and 看到 would just mean 'saw', not 'mistook for'.

items.s: 我把药没带来。
items.zh: 我没把药带来。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ yào dài lái
items.en: I didn't bring my medicine.
items.why: 没 must stand before 把, not between the object and the verb.
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ yào méi dài lái

items.src_py: wǒ shài gān le bèi zi
items.zh: 我把被子晒干了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ bèi zi shài gān le
items.en: I dried the quilt in the sun.
items.why: 把 moves the object 被子 in front of the verb, and the verb keeps its result 干 together with 了.

items.q: 他今天喝了___两杯热水，嗓子好多了。
items.zh: 他今天喝了两杯热水，嗓子好多了。
items.py: tā jīn tiān hē le liǎng bēi rè shuǐ sǎng zi hǎo duō le
items.en: He drank two cups of hot water today, and his throat is much better.
items.why: A new counted object (两杯热水) stays after the verb, so no 把 is used. 把 would need a specific, known object such as 那杯热水.

items.zh: 他还没把伤口包好。
items.py: tā hái méi bǎ shāng kǒu bāo hǎo
items.en: He hasn't bandaged the wound yet.
items.why: 还 and 没 both go before 把, and the verb keeps its result 包好 with no 了. 把伤口还没包好 is not possible.

items.q: 我___球衣洗干净了。
items.zh: 我把球衣洗干净了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ qiú yī xǐ gān jìng le
items.en: I washed the jersey clean.
items.why: A specific object plus a result (洗干净) is the 把 pattern: 把 + object before the verb. 被 would make the jersey the one doing the washing, and 在 and 对 cannot join a subject to an object this way.

items.q: 哥哥不小心把玻璃踢___了。
items.zh: 哥哥不小心把玻璃踢坏了。
items.py: gē ge bù xiǎo xīn bǎ bō lí tī huài le
items.en: My brother accidentally kicked the glass and broke it.
items.why: The result of the kick is that the glass broke, so the result complement is 坏. 走 would mean the glass moved away, and 到 and 在 need a destination after them, which this sentence does not give.

items.q: 他生气地把网球拍摔___了。
items.zh: 他生气地把网球拍摔坏了。
items.py: tā shēng qì de bǎ wǎng qiú pāi shuāi huài le
items.en: Angrily, he smashed his tennis racket and broke it.
items.why: 摔坏 gives the result of the throw: the racket is now broken. 着 and 过 are aspect markers, not results, and 给 would need a person who receives the racket.

items.q: 请把比赛的时间记___，别忘了。
items.zh: 请把比赛的时间记住，别忘了。
items.py: qǐng bǎ bǐ sài de shí jiān jì zhù bié wàng le
items.en: Please remember the match time, and do not forget it.
items.why: 记住 means to fix something in memory, which is what the second clause asks for. 记错 means to remember wrongly, and 记走 and 记掉 are not used in this sense.

items.q: 教练终于把队员们的错误动作都纠正___了。
items.zh: 教练终于把队员们的错误动作都纠正过来了。
items.py: jiào liàn zhōng yú bǎ duì yuán men de cuò wù dòng zuò dōu jiū zhèng guò lái le
items.en: The coach finally got all the players' wrong movements corrected.
items.why: 纠正过来 is the set result: bring a wrong habit back to right. 起来, 出来 and 下去 give directions that cannot be attached to 纠正 in this meaning.

items.q: 请把包里的球拍拿___来。
items.zh: 请把包里的球拍拿出来。
items.py: qǐng bǎ bāo lǐ de qiú pāi ná chū lái
items.en: Please take the racket out of the bag.
items.why: 拿出来 matches "out of the bag", and the object stays in front of the verb with 把. 进来 means in, 上来 up and 下来 down, which all contradict 包里.

items.q: 外面下雨了，快把自行车推___去吧。
items.zh: 外面下雨了，快把自行车推进去吧。
items.py: wài miàn xià yǔ le kuài bǎ zì xíng chē tuī jìn qù ba
items.en: It is raining outside, quick, push the bike inside.
items.why: Rain means the bike should go indoors, so 进 + 去. 出去 is the opposite direction, and 上去 and 起去 do not describe going into a place.

items.q: 比赛结束了，你把足球带___吧。
items.zh: 比赛结束了，你把足球带回去吧。
items.py: bǐ sài jié shù le nǐ bǎ zú qiú dài huí qù ba
items.en: The match is over, take the ball back with you.
items.why: 带回去 is taking something back to where it belongs, away from the speaker. 出来, 起来 and 上来 are directions of coming out or up, none of which means taking a ball home.

items.q: 裁判把黄牌从口袋里拿___，举了起来。
items.zh: 裁判把黄牌从口袋里拿出来，举了起来。
items.py: cái pàn bǎ huáng pái cóng kǒu dai lǐ ná chū lái jǔ le qǐ lái
items.en: The referee took the yellow card out of his pocket and held it up.
items.why: He takes the card out of the pocket, so 拿 + 出来, with the whole direction after the verb. 进去 would put it in, and 回去 and 下去 point to places the card does not go.

items.q: 地铁站的人太多，他好不容易才把婴儿车搬___了楼梯。
items.zh: 地铁站的人太多，他好不容易才把婴儿车搬下了楼梯。
items.py: dì tiě zhàn de rén tài duō tā hǎo bù róng yì cái bǎ yīng ér chē bān xià le lóu tī
items.en: The metro station was so crowded that he barely managed to carry the pram down the stairs.
items.why: The pram goes down the stairs, so 下 follows 搬 directly. 上 means up, and 过 and 出 mean across and out, which are not the movement described.

items.q: 我把自行车锁___公园门口了。
items.zh: 我把自行车锁在公园门口了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zì xíng chē suǒ zài gōng yuán mén kǒu le
items.en: I locked my bike at the park entrance.
items.why: 锁 + 在 + place says where the bike ends up locked, with the object brought forward by 把. 给 needs a person, 成 a new form and 走 a direction, so none of them can take 公园门口.

items.q: 司机把我们送___了火车站。
items.zh: 司机把我们送到了火车站。
items.py: sī jī bǎ wǒ men sòng dào le huǒ chē zhàn
items.en: The driver took us to the train station.
items.why: 送 + 到 means moving someone to a destination, and 火车站 is where we arrive. 给 is for a person receiving something, 在 for where something rests, and 成 for turning into something.

items.q: 教练把这份名单交___队长了。
items.zh: 教练把这份名单交给队长了。
items.py: jiào liàn bǎ zhè fèn míng dān jiāo gěi duì zhǎng le
items.en: The coach handed this list to the captain.
items.why: A person who receives the thing needs 给 after 交. 到 and 在 would need a place word, and 成 would mean turning the list into the captain.

items.q: 他把这首英文歌翻译___了中文。
items.zh: 他把这首英文歌翻译成了中文。
items.py: tā bǎ zhè shǒu yīng wén gē fān yì chéng le zhōng wén
items.en: He translated this English song into Chinese.
items.why: 翻译成 changes one form into another, and the new form 中文 follows directly. 给 would introduce a person, and 到 and 在 would introduce a place.

items.q: 我们都把他___球队的灵魂。
items.zh: 我们都把他当作球队的灵魂。
items.py: wǒ men dōu bǎ tā dàng zuò qiú duì de líng hún
items.en: We all regard him as the soul of the team.
items.why: 当作 means to treat as, and the role 球队的灵魂 follows right after it. 带到 and 放在 need a place, and 送给 needs a person who receives something.

items.q: 你把这瓶水喝___吧，比赛前要补水。
items.zh: 你把这瓶水喝了吧，比赛前要补水。
items.py: nǐ bǎ zhè píng shuǐ hē le ba bǐ sài qián yào bǔ shuǐ
items.en: Drink up this bottle of water, you need to rehydrate before the match.
items.why: A bare 喝 cannot end a 把 clause, and 了 is the lightest ending that works when a drink is used up. 着 and 过 do not complete the action, and 在 would need a place after it.

items.q: 他不想要了，就把那双旧球鞋扔___。
items.zh: 他不想要了，就把那双旧球鞋扔了。
items.py: tā bù xiǎng yào le jiù bǎ nà shuāng jiù qiú xié rēng le
items.en: He did not want them any more, so he threw the old sneakers away.
items.why: 扔 gets rid of the object, so 了 alone is enough to complete the 把 clause. A bare 扔 is not allowed, 着 means ongoing, and 在 would need a place after it.

items.q: 请把那件球衣试___，看合不合适。
items.zh: 请把那件球衣试一下，看合不合适。
items.py: qǐng bǎ nà jiàn qiú yī shì yī xià kàn hé bù hé shì
items.en: Please try that jersey on and see whether it fits.
items.why: A request with 把 needs a light ending after the verb, and 一下 gives "try it for a moment". 着 and 过 do not complete the action, and a bare 试 is not allowed.

items.q: 他把今天有比赛的事忘___，所以没带球鞋。
items.zh: 他把今天有比赛的事忘了，所以没带球鞋。
items.py: tā bǎ jīn tiān yǒu bǐ sài de shì wàng le suǒ yǐ méi dài qiú xié
items.en: He forgot that there was a match today, so he did not bring his sneakers.
items.why: 忘 means the thing is lost from memory, so 了 is enough to close a 把 clause. 过 would mean having forgotten at some time, 着 does not fit, and a bare 忘 is not allowed.

items.q: 我___把球拍带来，今天不能打球了。
items.zh: 我没把球拍带来，今天不能打球了。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ qiú pāi dài lái jīn tiān bù néng dǎ qiú le
items.en: I did not bring my racket, so I cannot play today.
items.why: 没 goes before 把 and says the action did not happen. 不 would mean refusing or a habit, 别 is a command, and 就 does not negate anything.

items.q: 打球的时候，___把手机放在场边。
items.zh: 打球的时候，别把手机放在场边。
items.py: dǎ qiú de shí hou bié bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài chǎng biān
items.en: Do not leave your phone at the side of the court while you play.
items.why: 别 before 把 gives a "don't" command, and the English cue is an instruction. 没 would report something that did not happen, and 不是 and 未 do not fit a command.

items.q: 你___把地图带上，免得迷路。
items.zh: 你最好把地图带上，免得迷路。
items.py: nǐ zuì hǎo bǎ dì tú dài shàng miǎn de mí lù
items.en: You had better take the map with you so you do not get lost.
items.why: 最好 is a modal-like adverb and, like all of them, it goes before 把. 因为 and 虽然 are conjunctions that would not make advice, and 刚才 would put the action in the past.

items.q: 地铁里人很多，请___把大背包放在地上。
items.zh: 地铁里人很多，请不要把大背包放在地上。
items.py: dì tiě lǐ rén hěn duō qǐng bú yào bǎ dà bēi bāo fàng zài dì shàng
items.en: The metro is crowded, so please do not put your big backpack on the floor.
items.why: 不要 before 把 forbids the action. 没有 reports something that did not happen, 不会 predicts, and 不用 means "no need to", which does not fit a polite request.

items.q: 我把___买回来了，你明天就能用。
items.zh: 我把你要的那个新篮球买回来了，你明天就能用。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nǐ yào de nà ge xīn lán qiú mǎi huí lái le nǐ míng tiān jiù néng yòng
items.en: I have bought back the new basketball you wanted, so you can use it tomorrow.
items.why: The 把 object must be something we can both identify, and 你要的那个新篮球 is exactly that. 一个新篮球 would introduce a new, unspecified ball and belongs after the verb instead.

items.q: 他很喜欢___这个城市的夜景。
items.zh: 他很喜欢这个城市的夜景。
items.py: tā hěn xǐ huan zhè ge chéng shì de yè jǐng
items.en: He really likes the night view of this city.
items.why: 喜欢 is a feeling verb that does nothing to its object, so it takes a plain object with no 把. Inserting 把 would leave the sentence waiting for another verb.

items.q: 昨天我没把球鞋带回家___。
items.zh: 昨天我没把球鞋带回家。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ méi bǎ qiú xié dài huí jiā
items.en: I did not take my sneakers home yesterday.
items.why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so 了 cannot be added at the end. The sentence stands with 没把 and the complete verb 带回家 alone.

items.zh: 弟弟把足球踢破了。
items.py: dì di bǎ zú qiú tī pò le
items.en: My brother kicked the football and burst it.
items.why: The ball goes between 把 and the verb, and the result 破 stays glued to 踢, with 了 last. Putting 足球 after 踢破了 would leave the 把 tile with nothing to do.

items.zh: 我把跑鞋穿坏了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ pǎo xié chuān huài le
items.en: I have worn out my running shoes.
items.why: The object follows 把 straight away, and 穿坏 stays together as verb plus result with 了 at the end. Splitting 坏 off from 穿 breaks the pattern.

items.zh: 教练把比赛场地记错了。
items.py: jiào liàn bǎ bǐ sài chǎng dì jì cuò le
items.en: The coach got the venue of the match wrong.
items.why: Subject, 把, the specific object, then verb plus result 记错, then 了. A 把 sentence never puts the object after the result complement.

items.zh: 请把球扔过来。
items.py: qǐng bǎ qiú rēng guò lái
items.en: Please throw the ball over here.
items.why: The object 球 comes directly after 把 and the verb with its direction (扔过来) follows as one block. The object cannot sit inside or after the direction.

items.zh: 他把自行车骑回去了。
items.py: tā bǎ zì xíng chē qí huí qù le
items.en: He rode the bike back.
items.why: 把 + object, then verb plus the full direction 骑回去, then 了. Moving 自行车 behind 骑回去 would put the object after the direction, which 把 does not allow.

items.zh: 服务员把菜端上来了。
items.py: fú wù yuán bǎ cài duān shàng lái le
items.en: The waiter brought the dishes out to the table.
items.why: The dishes go after 把, and 端上来 is a single verb-plus-direction block that ends the clause before 了. The direction cannot be separated from the verb.

items.zh: 比赛一结束，他就把球鞋脱下来了。
items.py: bǐ sài yī jié shù tā jiù bǎ qiú xié tuō xià lái le
items.en: As soon as the match ended, he took off his sneakers.
items.why: The time clause stands first, and 把 comes after 就 with the object in front of the verb 脱下来. 就 modifies the whole 把 phrase, so it cannot come between 把 and the object.

items.zh: 我把车停在路边了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ chē tíng zài lù biān le
items.en: I parked the car by the roadside.
items.why: 停在 + place says where the car ends up, so the car must go forward with 把. 路边 comes right after 停在, with nothing in between.

items.zh: 他把钥匙放在口袋里了。
items.py: tā bǎ yào shi fàng zài kǒu dai lǐ le
items.en: He put the keys in his pocket.
items.why: The object goes after 把, then 放在 + place. 放在 must be followed directly by 口袋里, and 钥匙 cannot be put after 放在.

items.zh: 司机把我们送到了地铁站。
items.py: sī jī bǎ wǒ men sòng dào le dì tiě zhàn
items.en: The driver took us to the metro station.
items.why: 把 + 我们 stands before the verb, and 送到 + destination ends the clause. The destination cannot come between 把 and the verb.

items.zh: 请把这封信交给那位工作人员。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jiāo gěi nà wèi gōng zuò rén yuán
items.en: Please hand this letter to that staff member.
items.why: 交给 + person needs the specific letter brought forward with 把. The receiver follows 交给 directly.

items.zh: 他把那本旅行指南翻译成了英文。
items.py: tā bǎ nà běn lǚ xíng zhǐ nán fān yì chéng le yīng wén
items.en: He translated that travel guide into English.
items.why: 翻译成 must be followed by the new form 英文, so the thing translated goes before the verb with 把. The 了 can sit before or after 英文.

items.zh: 他把那条狗牵到了公园里。
items.py: tā bǎ nà tiáo gǒu qiān dào le gōng yuán lǐ
items.en: He led the dog to the park.
items.why: 牵到 + place says where the dog is taken, so the dog goes before the verb with 把. The destination 公园里 stays right after 牵到.

items.zh: 妈妈没把钱包放在包里。
items.py: mā ma méi bǎ qián bāo fàng zài bāo lǐ
items.en: Mum did not put the wallet in the bag.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, not before the verb, and there is no 了 after 没. 放在包里 stays together as the end of the clause.

items.zh: 不要把垃圾扔在球场上。
items.py: bú yào bǎ lā jī rēng zài qiú chǎng shàng
items.en: Do not throw rubbish on the court.
items.why: 不要 comes before 把, and 扔在 is followed straight away by the place. 不要 cannot be moved between the object and 扔在.

items.zh: 你能把这张地图借给我吗？
items.py: nǐ néng bǎ zhè zhāng dì tú jiè gěi wǒ ma
items.en: Can you lend me this map?
items.why: The modal 能 comes before 把, and 吗 closes the question. 借给 + 我 forms one block after the object, so the object cannot follow 借给.

items.zh: 我马上把球鞋换好。
items.py: wǒ mǎ shàng bǎ qiú xié huàn hǎo
items.en: I will get my sneakers changed right away.
items.why: The adverb 马上 goes before 把, not before 换好. Placing it between 球鞋 and 换好 is the classic mistake.

items.zh: 教练还没把名单交给我们。
items.py: jiào liàn hái méi bǎ míng dān jiāo gěi wǒ men
items.en: The coach still has not handed the list to us.
items.why: 还没 stands before 把 as one unit, and 交给 + person follows the object. Negation cannot move to the verb.

items.zh: 我想把周末的比赛录下来。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhōu mò de bǐ sài lù xià lái
items.en: I want to record the weekend match.
items.why: The modal 想 comes before 把, and the object 周末的比赛 goes in front of 录下来. 想 cannot be put between the object and the verb.

items.zh: 你应该把这条路线记清楚。
items.py: nǐ yīng gāi bǎ zhè tiáo lù xiàn jì qīng chu
items.en: You should memorise this route properly.
items.why: The modal 应该 sits before 把, and the verb with its result 记清楚 comes last. 应该 between 这条路线 and 记清楚 would be wrong.

items.zh: 你把跑鞋擦一擦。
items.py: nǐ bǎ pǎo xié cā yi cā
items.en: Give your running shoes a wipe.
items.why: A bare 擦 is not allowed after 把, so the verb is doubled as 擦一擦. The object goes right after 把.

items.zh: 请把球场打扫一下。
items.py: qǐng bǎ qiú chǎng dǎ sǎo yī xià
items.en: Please tidy up the court a bit.
items.why: 打扫 needs 一下 after it to complete the 把 clause. The object 球场 stays between 把 and the verb.

items.zh: 他把外套脱了。
items.py: tā bǎ wài tào tuō le
items.en: He took off his coat.
items.why: 脱 removes the object, so 了 alone completes the 把 clause. The object must come before 脱, and a bare 脱 would be incomplete.

items.zh: 我买了一双新球鞋。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng xīn qiú xié
items.en: I bought a pair of new sneakers.
items.why: "A pair of new sneakers" is new information, not something the listener can identify, so it stays after the verb. 把 needs a specific object, so the extra tile 把 is not used.

items.zh: 我看不懂这张地图。
items.py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè zhāng dì tú
items.en: I cannot understand this map.
items.why: A "can't manage" complement (看不懂) never combines with 把, so the object stays after the verb. The extra 把 tile would make the sentence wrong.

items.src_py: tā tī huài le lín jū de chuāng hu
items.zh: 他把邻居的窗户踢坏了。
items.py: tā bǎ lín jū de chuāng hu tī huài le
items.en: He kicked the neighbour's window and broke it.
items.why: 把 moves the object in front of the verb, and 踢坏 keeps its result with 了 at the end.

items.src_py: wǒ dǎ wán le zhè chǎng bǐ sài
items.zh: 我把这场比赛打完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zhè chǎng bǐ sài dǎ wán le
items.en: I finished playing this match.
items.why: The object 这场比赛 goes between 把 and the verb, and 打完 stays together with 了 after it.

items.src: 他看清楚了路牌上的字。
items.src_py: tā kàn qīng chu le lù pái shàng de zì
items.zh: 他把路牌上的字看清楚了。
items.py: tā bǎ lù pái shàng de zì kàn qīng chu le
items.en: He read the words on the street sign clearly.
items.why: Even a perception verb takes 把 when a real result (清楚) follows. The object goes before 看清楚 and 了 closes the clause.

items.src: 我把那本旅游书看完了。
items.src_py: wǒ bǎ nà běn lǚ yóu shū kàn wán le
items.zh: 我看完了那本旅游书。
items.py: wǒ kàn wán le nà běn lǚ yóu shū
items.en: I finished that travel book.
items.why: Without 把 the object returns to its normal place after the verb and its result, and 了 follows the result: 看完了那本旅游书.

items.src: 妹妹弄丢了我的球拍，所以我很生气。
items.src_py: mèi mei nòng diū le wǒ de qiú pāi suǒ yǐ wǒ hěn shēng qì
items.task: Rewrite the first clause with 把.
items.zh: 妹妹把我的球拍弄丢了，所以我很生气。
items.py: mèi mei bǎ wǒ de qiú pāi nòng diū le suǒ yǐ wǒ hěn shēng qì
items.en: My little sister lost my racket, so I am angry.
items.why: The first clause becomes 妹妹把我的球拍弄丢了, with the object before 弄丢 and 了 after it. The second clause is unchanged.

items.src_py: qǐng ná chū qiú lái
items.zh: 请把球拿出来。
items.py: qǐng bǎ qiú ná chū lái
items.en: Please take the ball out.
items.why: With 把 the object 球 goes right after it, and the verb with its direction 拿出来 follows as one block.

items.src_py: tā dài zǒu le nà ge lán qiú
items.zh: 他把那个篮球带走了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà ge lán qiú dài zǒu le
items.en: He took that basketball away.
items.why: The specific ball goes after 把, and 带走 keeps its direction right behind the verb with 了 at the end.

items.src_py: tā ná zǒu le wǒ de shuǐ píng
items.zh: 她把我的水瓶拿走了。
items.py: tā bǎ wǒ de shuǐ píng ná zǒu le
items.en: She took my water bottle.
items.why: 我的水瓶 is specific, so it can follow 把, and 拿走 stays together before 了.

items.src: 他从背包里拿出了跑鞋。
items.src_py: tā cóng bēi bāo lǐ ná chū le pǎo xié
items.zh: 他把跑鞋从背包里拿出来了。
items.py: tā bǎ pǎo xié cóng bēi bāo lǐ ná chū lái le
items.en: He took the running shoes out of his backpack.
items.why: The object goes after 把 and 拿出来 ends the clause. The 从 phrase can also stand before 把.

items.src: 比赛结束后，所有的球门志愿者都收起来了。
items.src_py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu suǒ yǒu de qiú mén zhì yuàn zhě dōu shōu qǐ lái le
items.zh: 比赛结束后，志愿者把所有的球门都收起来了。
items.py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu zhì yuàn zhě bǎ suǒ yǒu de qiú mén dōu shōu qǐ lái le
items.en: After the match, the volunteers put all the goals away.
items.why: The summing-up 都 comes after the 把 object and before the verb. The time phrase can also stand after the subject.

items.src_py: qiú xié wǒ fàng zài mén kǒu le
items.zh: 我把球鞋放在门口了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ qiú xié fàng zài mén kǒu le
items.en: I put my sneakers by the door.
items.why: The fronted object returns after 把 and the subject, followed by 放在 + place. 放在 must be followed directly by 门口.

items.src_py: wǒ hái le péng you nà běn shū
items.zh: 我把那本书还给了朋友。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū huán gěi le péng you
items.en: I gave that book back to my friend.
items.why: The specific book goes after 把 and the receiver follows 还给. The 了 can sit before or after 朋友.

items.src: 那张照片他放在钱包里了。
items.src_py: nà zhāng zhào piān tā fàng zài qián bāo lǐ le
items.zh: 他把那张照片放在钱包里了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà zhāng zhào piān fàng zài qián bāo lǐ le
items.en: He put that photo in his wallet.
items.why: The fronted object moves back behind the subject with 把, and 放在 + place follows as one block.

items.src_py: qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng piào jiāo gěi tā
items.zh: 请交给他这张票。
items.py: qǐng jiāo gěi tā zhè zhāng piào
items.en: Please hand him this ticket.
items.why: Without 把 the person goes straight after 交给 and the thing handed over follows: 请交给他这张票.

items.src: 他认为球场是自己的家。
items.src_py: tā rèn wéi qiú chǎng shì zì jǐ de jiā
items.task: Say he treats it as his own home, using 把.
items.zh: 他把球场当作自己的家。
items.py: tā bǎ qiú chǎng dàng zuò zì jǐ de jiā
items.en: He treats the pitch as his own home.
items.why: 把…当作… expresses treating something as something else. The object goes before 当作 and the new role follows it directly.

items.src: 导游带游客们到了城市中心的广场。
items.src_py: dǎo yóu dài yóu kè men dào le chéng shì zhōng xīn de guǎng chǎng
items.zh: 导游把游客们带到了城市中心的广场。
items.py: dǎo yóu bǎ yóu kè men dài dào le chéng shì zhōng xīn de guǎng chǎng
items.en: The guide took the tourists to the square in the city centre.
items.why: The tourists move to before the verb with 把, and 带到 + destination ends the clause. The 了 can follow 带到 or the destination.

items.src: 这篇比赛报道，他翻译成英文了。
items.src_py: zhè piān bǐ sài bào dào tā fān yì chéng yīng wén le
items.zh: 他把这篇比赛报道翻译成英文了。
items.py: tā bǎ zhè piān bǐ sài bào dào fān yì chéng yīng wén le
items.en: He translated this match report into English.
items.why: The fronted object returns after the subject with 把, and 翻译成 is followed by the new form 英文. The 了 can sit before or after 英文.

items.src_py: tā mài le nà liàng jiù mó tuō chē
items.zh: 他把那辆旧摩托车卖了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà liàng jiù mó tuō chē mài le
items.en: He sold that old motorbike.
items.why: 卖 gets rid of its object, so 了 alone is enough after 把. The specific motorbike goes before the verb.

items.src_py: qǐng shuā shua qiú xié
items.task: Ask politely with 把 and a doubled verb.
items.zh: 请把球鞋刷一刷。
items.py: qǐng bǎ qiú xié shuā yī shuā
items.en: Please give the sneakers a scrub.
items.why: Rewritten with 把, the verb cannot stay bare, so it is doubled as 刷一刷. The object goes right after 把.

items.src: 他忘了那场比赛的时间。
items.src_py: tā wàng le nà chǎng bǐ sài de shí jiān
items.zh: 他把那场比赛的时间忘了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà chǎng bǐ sài de shí jiān wàng le
items.en: He forgot the time of that match.
items.why: 忘 loses the object from memory, so 了 alone completes the 把 clause. The object goes before 忘.

items.src_py: tā bǎ dì tú ná chū lái le
items.zh: 他没把地图拿出来。
items.py: tā méi bǎ dì tú ná chū lái
items.en: He did not take the map out.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, not before the verb, and 了 is dropped. 他把地图没拿出来 is the classic error.

items.src_py: nǐ bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài dì shàng le
items.task: Tell him not to do it.
items.zh: 别把手机放在地上。
items.py: bié bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài dì shàng
items.en: Do not put your phone on the floor.
items.why: A command is made with 别 before 把, and 了 is dropped. 别 cannot be moved to the verb.

items.src: 他把球队的新名单告诉我了。
items.src_py: tā bǎ qiú duì de xīn míng dān gào su wǒ le
items.zh: 他没把球队的新名单告诉我。
items.py: tā méi bǎ qiú duì de xīn míng dān gào su wǒ
items.en: He did not tell me the team's new list.
items.why: 没 stands before 把 and 了 disappears. The negator never goes between the object and the verb.

items.src: 我看完这本关于游泳的书。
items.src_py: wǒ kàn wán zhè běn guān yú yóu yǒng de shū
items.task: Say you want to do it, using 把.
items.zh: 我想把这本关于游泳的书看完。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè běn guān yú yóu yǒng de shū kàn wán
items.en: I want to finish this book about swimming.
items.why: The modal 想 comes before 把, and the object goes in front of 看完. 了 is not used because the action has not happened yet.

items.src: 我买好了去体育馆的票。
items.src_py: wǒ mǎi hǎo le qù tǐ yù guǎn de piào
items.task: Say you already did it, using 把.
items.zh: 我已经把去体育馆的票买好了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ qù tǐ yù guǎn de piào mǎi hǎo le
items.en: I have already bought the tickets to the stadium.
items.why: 已经 goes before 把, the object before the verb, and 买好了 keeps its result and 了 at the end.

items.src: 他把借的足球还给我了。
items.src_py: tā bǎ jiè de zú qiú huán gěi wǒ le
items.zh: 他还没把借的足球还给我。
items.py: tā hái méi bǎ jiè de zú qiú huán gěi wǒ
items.en: He still has not given the football he borrowed back to me.
items.why: 还没 goes before 把 as a unit, and 了 is dropped. 还给 + person follows the object.

items.src: 我昨天看完了那本关于足球的书。
items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn wán le nà běn guān yú zú qiú de shū
items.zh: 我昨天把那本关于足球的书看完了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ nà běn guān yú zú qiú de shū kàn wán le
items.en: I finished that book about football yesterday.
items.why: The specific book (那本…) can go after 把. The time word can come before or after the subject, but must precede 把.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ nà bēi guǒ zhī hē wán le
items.task: Say it was two glasses of juice, in plain order.
items.zh: 我喝完了两杯果汁。
items.py: wǒ hē wán le liǎng bēi guǒ zhī
items.en: I finished two glasses of juice.
items.why: "Two glasses of juice" is a new counted object, so it follows the verb instead of 把.

items.src: 我今天能把这些路线图看完。
items.src_py: wǒ jīn tiān néng bǎ zhè xiē lù xiàn tú kàn wán
items.task: Say you cannot finish them today.
items.zh: 我今天看不完这些路线图。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān kàn bù wán zhè xiē lù xiàn tú
items.en: I cannot finish looking at these route maps today.
items.why: A "can't manage" complement (看不完) never combines with 把, so the object goes after the verb.

items.src_py: tā bǎ nà chǎng bǐ sài kàn wán le
items.task: Say he is watching it right now, with no 把.
items.zh: 他正在看那场比赛。
items.py: tā zhèng zài kàn nà chǎng bǐ sài
items.en: He is watching that match right now.
items.why: An action in progress has no finished result for 把 to build on, so use plain 正在 + verb + object.

items.s: 我把足球很喜欢。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zú qiú hěn xǐ huan
items.zh: 我很喜欢足球。
items.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zú qiú
items.en: I really like football.
items.why: 喜欢 does nothing to its object, so it never takes 把. The plain order 我很喜欢足球 is the only option.

items.s: 我昨天在公园把小王看见了。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān zài gōng yuán bǎ xiǎo wáng kàn jiàn le
items.zh: 我昨天在公园看见小王了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài gōng yuán kàn jiàn xiǎo wáng le
items.en: I saw Xiao Wang in the park yesterday.
items.why: 看见 only records a perception and leaves 小王 unchanged, so 把 is not possible. Plain SVO with 了 at the end is correct.

items.s: 我把教练的电话号码忘了。
items.zh: 我把教练的电话号码忘了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ jiào liàn de diàn huà hào mǎ wàng le
items.en: I forgot the coach's phone number.
items.why: 忘 is a mental verb, but it does take 把 because the thing is lost, and 了 completes the clause. Do not reject it just for being a mental verb.

items.s: 我把教练说的话听清楚了。
items.zh: 我把教练说的话听清楚了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ jiào liàn shuō de huà tīng qīng chu le
items.en: I heard what the coach said clearly.
items.why: 听 normally resists 把, but here a real result 清楚 follows, so the words are dealt with and 把 is fine.

items.s: 他把北京去了。
items.s_py: tā bǎ běi jīng qù le
items.zh: 他去了北京。
items.py: tā qù le běi jīng
items.en: He went to Beijing.
items.why: 去 is a movement verb that does not act on its object, so 把 cannot be used. 北京 is just where he went.

items.s: 我把这个城市很熟悉。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge chéng shì hěn shú xī
items.zh: 我很熟悉这个城市。
items.py: wǒ hěn shú xī zhè ge chéng shì
items.en: I know this city very well.
items.why: 熟悉 describes a state of knowing and does nothing to the city, so 把 is impossible. Plain SVO is the only form.

items.s: 我把水壶没带来。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ shuǐ hú méi dài lái
items.zh: 我没把水壶带来。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ shuǐ hú dài lái
items.en: I did not bring my water bottle.
items.why: 没 must stand before 把, not between the object and the verb. 没把球拍带来 is the correct order.

items.s: 你把车可以停在路边。
items.s_py: nǐ bǎ chē kě yǐ tíng zài lù biān
items.zh: 你可以把车停在路边。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chē tíng zài lù biān
items.en: You can park the car by the roadside.
items.why: Modal verbs such as 可以 stand before 把. Putting 可以 after the object breaks the 把 pattern.

items.s: 别把雨伞忘在地铁里。
items.zh: 别把雨伞忘在地铁里。
items.py: bié bǎ yǔ sǎn wàng zài dì tiě lǐ
items.en: Do not leave your umbrella on the metro.
items.why: 别 stands before 把, and 忘在地铁里 gives the place where the umbrella ends up left. Nothing is wrong with it.

items.s: 他把车已经开走了。
items.s_py: tā bǎ chē yǐ jīng kāi zǒu le
items.zh: 他已经把车开走了。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng bǎ chē kāi zǒu le
items.en: He has already driven the car away.
items.why: Time adverbs such as 已经 go before 把, never after the object. 已经把车开走了 is correct.

items.s: 我昨天把桌上那杯咖啡喝完了。
items.zh: 我昨天把桌上那杯咖啡喝完了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ zhuō shàng nà bēi kā fēi hē wán le
items.en: I finished the cup of coffee on the table yesterday.
items.why: 桌上那杯咖啡 points to one identifiable cup and 喝完 gives a result, so 把 is right. A new counted object such as 一杯咖啡 would stay after the verb instead.

items.s: 他把那瓶水喝完了。
items.zh: 他把那瓶水喝完了。
items.py: tā bǎ nà píng shuǐ hē wán le
items.en: He finished that bottle of water.
items.why: 那瓶水 is specific and 喝完 gives a result, so the 把 sentence is fully correct.

items.s: 我把朋友借给我的球拍弄坏了。
items.zh: 我把朋友借给我的球拍弄坏了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ péng you jiè gěi wǒ de qiú pāi nòng huài le
items.en: I broke the racket my friend lent me.
items.why: The long modifier 朋友借给我的 makes the racket identifiable, and 弄坏了 gives a result. 把 is correct.

items.s: 他把这条路线走不完。
items.s_py: tā bǎ zhè tiáo lù xiàn zǒu bù wán
items.zh: 他走不完这条路线。
items.py: tā zǒu bù wán zhè tiáo lù xiàn
items.en: He cannot finish walking this route.
items.why: 走不完 says the result cannot be reached, and 把 needs a result that is reached, so they never combine.

items.s: 我每天早上把牛奶喝。
items.s_py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng bǎ niú nǎi hē
items.zh: 我每天早上喝牛奶。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng hē niú nǎi
items.en: I drink milk every morning.
items.why: A daily habit has no single result to build on, and a bare 喝 after 把 is not allowed. Use plain SVO.

items.s: 我每个周末都在公园踢足球。
items.zh: 我每个周末都在公园踢足球。
items.py: wǒ měi gè zhōu mò dōu zài gōng yuán tī zú qiú
items.en: I play football in the park every weekend.
items.why: A habit takes plain SVO, which is what this sentence has. It would be wrong to force 把 into it.

items.s: 我把喝完了那杯茶。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ hē wán le nà bēi chá
items.zh: 我把那杯茶喝完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà bēi chá hē wán le
items.en: I finished that cup of tea.
items.why: The object goes right after 把, before the verb. Leaving 那杯茶 after 喝完了 means 把 has nothing to attach to.

items.s: 志愿者把搬进去了桌子。
items.s_py: zhì yuàn zhě bǎ bān jìn qù le zhuō zi
items.zh: 志愿者把桌子搬进去了。
items.py: zhì yuàn zhě bǎ zhuō zi bān jìn qù le
items.en: The volunteer carried the table inside.
items.why: The object must come directly after 把 and the verb with its direction follows. 搬进去 cannot come before the object, and 了 goes after the direction.

items.s: 我把这个电话号码写在手心上了。
items.zh: 我把这个电话号码写在手心上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge diàn huà hào mǎ xiě zài shǒu xīn shàng le
items.en: I wrote this phone number on the palm of my hand.
items.why: 写在 + place needs the specific number before the verb with 把, which is exactly what this sentence does.

items.s: 他把钱包放了在桌子上。
items.s_py: tā bǎ qián bāo fàng le zài zhuō zi shàng
items.zh: 他把钱包放在桌子上了。
items.py: tā bǎ qián bāo fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.en: He put his wallet on the table.
items.why: 放在 is a unit and nothing, not even 了, can come between 放 and 在. 了 goes after the whole phrase.
